meridians.descriptionZh: 起于中焦，下络大肠，还循胃口，上膈属肺，从肺系横出腋下，循臑臂内侧前缘，下肘入寸口，上鱼际，出大指桡侧端少商。属肺络大肠，主气司呼吸，通调水道，主皮毛。气血流注时辰为寅时（3-5时）。要穴有中府（LU-1）、尺泽（LU-5）、列缺（LU-7，八脉交会穴通任脉）、太渊（LU-9，脉会）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Originates in the middle jiao, descends to network with the Large Intestine, circles back to the cardia of the stomach, traverses the diaphragm, and pertains to the Lung; emerges laterally from the lung system below the axilla and runs down the anterior aspect of the medial upper arm and forearm, through the wrist at the cun-kou pulse, across the thenar eminence, to terminate at Shaoshang (LU-11) on the radial tip of the thumb. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Large Intestine, the Lung channel governs qi and respiration, regulates the water passages, and rules the skin and body hair; qi flows strongest here in the Tiger hour (3-5 am). Key points include Zhongfu (LU-1, front-mu), Chize (LU-5, he-sea) and Lieque (LU-7, luo and master of the Ren Mai).

meridians.namePinyin: Shǒu Yáng Míng Dà Cháng Jīng
meridians.descriptionZh: 起于食指末端商阳穴，循指上廉，出合谷两骨之间，上入两筋之中，沿前臂桡侧、上臂外侧前缘，上肩出髃骨之前，上颈贯颊入下齿，还出夹口交人中，止于对侧鼻翼旁迎香穴。下入缺盆络肺，下膈属大肠。主治头面五官、咽喉、热病及经脉循行部位疾患。气血流注时辰为卯时（5-7时）。要穴有合谷（LI-4，原穴）、曲池（LI-11，合穴）、迎香（LI-20）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Shangyang (LI-1) on the radial tip of the index finger, ascends the radial side of the hand through Hegu (LI-4) between the first and second metacarpals, runs up the lateral forearm and anterior aspect of the upper arm to the shoulder at Jianyu (LI-15), crosses to the opposite side at the philtrum, and terminates at Yingxiang (LI-20) beside the nostril. An internal branch enters the supraclavicular fossa, networks with the Lung, descends through the diaphragm, and pertains to the Large Intestine. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Lung, it clears heat, benefits the head, face, teeth and throat, and treats disorders along its course; qi peaks in the Rabbit hour (5-7 am). Key points include Hegu (LI-4, yuan-source), Quchi (LI-11, he-sea) and Yingxiang (LI-20).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于鼻翼旁迎香穴，上行至鼻根，入上齿龈，环绕口唇，经大迎、颊车，上耳前至额角头维。颈部支脉下缺盆入胸腹，络脾属胃。外行经脉沿胸腹第二侧线下行至气冲、髀关，循大腿前外、胫骨外缘、足背，入第二趾外侧端厉兑。属胃络脾，多气多血，主受纳腐熟，为后天之本。气血流注时辰为辰时（7-9时）。要穴有足三里（ST-36）、天枢（ST-25，大肠募）、丰隆（ST-40，络穴）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Yingxiang (LI-20) beside the nose, circles the upper teeth and lips, descends through the face and neck to the supraclavicular fossa, traverses the chest and abdomen along the second lateral line, networks with the Spleen and pertains to the Stomach, then continues down the anterolateral thigh and lower leg to end at Lidui (ST-45) on the lateral tip of the second toe. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Spleen, Foot-Yangming is rich in both qi and blood; it governs the reception and ripening of food and drink and is regarded as the root of postnatal qi, treating digestive, facial, breast and anterior-leg disorders. Qi flows strongest in the Dragon hour (7-9 am). Key points include Zusanli (ST-36, he-sea and command point for the abdomen), Tianshu (ST-25, front-mu of the Large Intestine) and Fenglong (ST-40, luo-connecting).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于足大趾内侧端隐白穴，沿大趾赤白肉际，过核骨后上内踝前，循小腿内侧胫骨后缘上行，过膝股内侧前缘入腹，属脾络胃，上膈夹咽连舌本，散舌下。胸部支脉注心中，接手少阴。属脾络胃，主运化水谷、统血、主肌肉四肢，为气血生化之源。气血流注时辰为巳时（9-11时）。要穴有三阴交（SP-6）、阴陵泉（SP-9，合穴）、血海（SP-10）、公孙（SP-4，八脉交会通冲脉）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Yinbai (SP-1) on the medial tip of the great toe, ascends the medial red-white skin border of the foot, passes anterior to the medial malleolus and up the posterior border of the tibia on the medial lower leg, continues up the anterior medial thigh into the abdomen, pertains to the Spleen and networks with the Stomach, then crosses the diaphragm to flank the throat and spread beneath the tongue; a chest branch rejoins the Heart to link with Hand-Shaoyin. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Stomach, Foot-Taiyin governs the transformation and transport of food and fluids, contains the blood within the vessels, and rules the muscles and four limbs as the source of postnatal qi and blood; qi is strongest in the Snake hour (9-11 am). Key points include Sanyinjiao (SP-6, meeting of the three yin), Yinlingquan (SP-9, he-sea) and Gongsun (SP-4, luo and master of the Chong Mai).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于心中，出属心系，下膈络小肠。其支者从心系上夹咽，系目系；其直者复从心系却上肺，下出腋下极泉，循臑臂内侧后缘，过肘内、掌后锐骨，入掌内后廉，循小指桡侧出其端少冲。属心络小肠，主血脉，藏神明，为君主之官。气血流注时辰为午时（11-13时）。要穴有神门（HT-7，原穴）、少海（HT-3，合穴）、通里（HT-5，络穴）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Originates in the Heart, emerges from the Heart system, descends through the diaphragm, and networks with the Small Intestine; a branch ascends alongside the throat to link with the eye system, while the main pathway passes upward to the lung, emerges at Jiquan (HT-1) in the axilla, and runs down the posterior medial aspect of the upper arm and forearm past the pisiform bone into the palm, ending at Shaochong (HT-9) on the radial tip of the little finger. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Small Intestine, Hand-Shaoyin governs the blood vessels and houses the shen (mind), serving as the sovereign organ; qi flows most strongly in the Horse hour (11 am-1 pm). Key points include Shenmen (HT-7, yuan-source and shu-stream), Shaohai (HT-3, he-sea) and Tongli (HT-5, luo-connecting).

meridians.namePinyin: Shǒu Tài Yáng Xiǎo Cháng Jīng
meridians.descriptionZh: 起于小指外侧端少泽，沿手背尺侧、前臂尺骨下缘上行，过尺骨鹰嘴与肱骨内上髁之间，沿上臂后内侧出肩后，绕肩胛，交会于大椎，入缺盆络心，循咽下膈抵胃，属小肠。面颊支脉上至目锐眦入耳中听宫。属小肠络心，主液，分清泌浊。气血流注时辰为未时（13-15时）。要穴有后溪（SI-3，八脉交会通督脉）、养老（SI-6，郄穴）、听宫（SI-19）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Shaoze (SI-1) on the ulnar tip of the little finger, ascends the ulnar border of the hand and forearm, passes between the olecranon and the medial epicondyle of the humerus, traces the posteromedial upper arm to the shoulder, winds around the scapula and meets Dazhui (DU-14), then enters the supraclavicular fossa to network with the Heart, descends through the diaphragm to the Stomach, and pertains to the Small Intestine; a facial branch ascends via the cheek to the outer canthus and ends at Tinggong (SI-19) anterior to the tragus. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Heart, Hand-Taiyang governs body fluids and separates the clear from the turbid; qi is most active in the Goat hour (1-3 pm). Key points include Houxi (SI-3, master of the Du Mai), Yanglao (SI-6, xi-cleft) and Tinggong (SI-19).

meridians.namePinyin: Zú Tài Yáng Páng Guāng Jīng
meridians.descriptionZh: 起于目内眦睛明穴，上额交巅百会，从巅入络脑，还出别下项，挟脊抵腰中，入循膂络肾属膀胱。腰部支脉贯臀下行至腘中；项部支脉循肩膊内，挟脊下行至髀枢，沿大腿后侧下合腘中，再下经小腿后侧、外踝后，沿足背至小趾外侧端至阴。属膀胱络肾，主一身之表，司气化而行水，背俞穴汇聚五脏六腑之气。全身经脉最长、穴位最多（67穴）。气血流注时辰为申时（15-17时）。要穴有委中（BL-40，合穴）、昆仑（BL-60）、至阴（BL-67）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Jingming (BL-1) at the medial canthus, ascends the forehead to the vertex at Baihui (DU-20) and enters the brain, re-emerges and runs down the neck alongside the spine to the lumbar region, networks with the Kidney and pertains to the Bladder; two parallel back branches descend either side of the spine, rejoin at the popliteal fossa, and continue down the posterior calf behind the lateral malleolus along the lateral foot to Zhiyin (BL-67) at the lateral tip of the little toe. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Kidney, Foot-Taiyang governs the exterior of the body, transforms fluids through qi, and carries the back-shu points that reflect every zang-fu. It is the longest channel, with 67 points; qi flows strongest in the Monkey hour (3-5 pm). Key points include Weizhong (BL-40, he-sea and command point of the back), Kunlun (BL-60, jing-river) and Zhiyin (BL-67).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于足小趾之下，斜走足心涌泉，出然谷之下，循内踝后入跟中，上踹内出腘内廉，上股内后廉贯脊属肾络膀胱。直行者从肾上贯肝膈，入肺中，循喉咙挟舌本；支者从肺出络心，注胸中接手厥阴。属肾络膀胱，藏精主生殖、主水、主纳气、主骨生髓，为先天之本。气血流注时辰为酉时（17-19时）。要穴有涌泉（KI-1，井穴）、太溪（KI-3，原穴）、照海（KI-6，八脉交会通阴跷）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts beneath the little toe, runs obliquely through the sole at Yongquan (KI-1), emerges below the navicular tuberosity, curves behind the medial malleolus into the heel, ascends the medial calf and the posteromedial thigh, pierces the spine, pertains to the Kidney and networks with the Bladder; the main internal branch rises from the Kidney through the Liver and diaphragm into the Lung and along the throat to the root of the tongue, while a chest branch links with the Heart to meet Hand-Jueyin. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Bladder, Foot-Shaoyin stores jing and governs reproduction, water metabolism, the grasping of qi, and the bones and marrow, forming the root of prenatal qi; qi peaks in the Rooster hour (5-7 pm). Key points include Yongquan (KI-1, jing-well), Taixi (KI-3, yuan-source) and Zhaohai (KI-6, master of the Yin Qiao Mai).

meridians.namePinyin: Shǒu Jué Yīn Xīn Bāo Jīng
meridians.descriptionZh: 起于胸中，出属心包络，下膈历络上、中、下三焦。胸部支脉循胸出胁，下腋三寸天池，上抵腋下，沿上臂内侧行太阴少阴之间，入肘中曲泽，下前臂两筋之间，过腕入掌中劳宫，循中指出其端中冲。属心包络三焦，代心行令，主血脉而护心神，为臣使之官。气血流注时辰为戌时（19-21时）。要穴有内关（PC-6，络穴通阴维）、大陵（PC-7，原穴）、劳宫（PC-8，荥穴）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Originates in the chest, pertains to the Pericardium, and descends through the diaphragm to network with the upper, middle and lower divisions of the Sanjiao; an external branch emerges from the chest at Tianchi (PC-1) three cun below the axilla, ascends to the armpit, then runs down the medial upper arm between the Taiyin and Shaoyin channels, through Quze (PC-3) at the elbow and between the two tendons of the forearm, crosses the wrist into the palm at Laogong (PC-8), and terminates at Zhongchong (PC-9) on the tip of the middle finger. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Sanjiao, Hand-Jueyin acts as the envoy of the Heart, protecting the shen and governing the blood vessels, treating cardiac, chest, stomach and mental-emotional disorders; qi flows strongest in the Dog hour (7-9 pm). Key points include Neiguan (PC-6, luo and master of the Yin Wei Mai), Daling (PC-7, yuan-source) and Laogong (PC-8, ying-spring).

meridians.namePinyin: Shǒu Shào Yáng Sān Jiāo Jīng
meridians.descriptionZh: 起于无名指末端关冲，上行手背第四、五掌骨之间，沿前臂背侧尺桡两骨之间，过肘尖天井，沿上臂外侧上肩，交出足少阳之后，入缺盆，散布膻中散络心包，下膈遍属上、中、下三焦。颈项支脉系耳后翳风，出耳前交颊至目锐眦丝竹空接足少阳。属三焦络心包，总司诸气、疏通水道，主腠理，为决渎之官。气血流注时辰为亥时（21-23时）。要穴有外关（SJ-5，络穴通阳维）、支沟（SJ-6，经穴）、翳风（SJ-17）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Guanchong (SJ-1) on the ulnar tip of the ring finger, ascends the back of the hand between the fourth and fifth metacarpals, runs up the posterior forearm between the radius and ulna, crosses the olecranon at Tianjing (SJ-10), continues along the lateral upper arm and shoulder posterior to Foot-Shaoyang, enters the supraclavicular fossa, spreads through the thoracic diaphragm to network with the Pericardium, descends through the diaphragm, and pertains to the upper, middle and lower divisions of the Sanjiao; a cranial branch loops the ear at Yifeng (SJ-17), crosses the cheek, and ends at Sizhukong (SJ-23) beside the lateral eyebrow. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Pericardium, Hand-Shaoyang governs the qi mechanism of the whole body and the movement of fluids through the water passages as the 'minister of the sluices'; qi is strongest in the Pig hour (9-11 pm). Key points include Waiguan (SJ-5, luo and master of the Yang Wei Mai), Zhigou (SJ-6, jing-river) and Yifeng (SJ-17).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于目外眦瞳子髎，上抵头角颔厌，下耳后完骨，折回上行经额部至眉上阳白，再向后至风池，沿颈下肩入缺盆。胸腹支脉贯膈络肝属胆，沿胁里下至气街，绕毛际横入髀厌环跳。沿大腿、膝、小腿外侧，出外踝之前，循足背入第四趾外侧端足窍阴。属胆络肝，主决断，司风木升发之气，为中正之官。气血流注时辰为子时（23-1时）。要穴有风池（GB-20）、环跳（GB-30）、阳陵泉（GB-34，合穴、筋会）、悬钟（GB-39，髓会）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Tongziliao (GB-1) at the outer canthus, zigzags across the temporal and occipital regions above and behind the ear, descends the neck to the shoulder, and enters the supraclavicular fossa; an internal branch pierces the diaphragm to network with the Liver and pertain to the Gallbladder, runs along the inner flank to the inguinal region, and rejoins the external pathway at Huantiao (GB-30) in the hip, which then descends the lateral thigh, knee and lower leg, passes anterior to the lateral malleolus along the dorsum of the foot, and terminates at Zuqiaoyin (GB-44) on the lateral tip of the fourth toe. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Liver, Foot-Shaoyang governs decision-making and the free ascent of wood qi as the 'upright judge', treating the sides of the head, ear, eye, flank and lateral-leg disorders; qi peaks in the Rat hour (11 pm-1 am). Key points include Fengchi (GB-20), Huantiao (GB-30) and Yanglingquan (GB-34, he-sea and meeting point of the sinews).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于足大趾爪甲后丛毛处大敦，沿足背上行过内踝前一寸中封，至内踝上八寸交出足太阴之后，上腘内廉曲泉，沿股内入阴毛中，环阴器抵小腹，挟胃属肝络胆，上贯膈布胁肋，循喉咙之后，上入颃颡连目系，上出额与督脉会于巅顶百会。属肝络胆，主疏泄，藏血，主筋，开窍于目，为将军之官。气血流注时辰为丑时（1-3时）。要穴有太冲（LR-3，原穴）、期门（LR-14，肝募）、章门（LR-13，脾募、脏会）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Starts at Dadun (LR-1) behind the nail of the great toe, ascends the dorsum of the foot through Zhongfeng (LR-4) one cun anterior to the medial malleolus, crosses behind Foot-Taiyin eight cun above the ankle, continues up the medial calf and thigh to the pubic region, circles the genitals and enters the lower abdomen, flanks the Stomach to pertain to the Liver and network with the Gallbladder, then pierces the diaphragm, spreads across the flanks, runs behind the throat into the nasopharynx, links with the eye system, and rises through the forehead to meet the Du Mai at Baihui (DU-20) on the vertex. Paired interior-exteriorly with the Gallbladder, Foot-Jueyin governs the free coursing of qi, stores the blood, rules the sinews and opens into the eyes as the 'general of the body'; qi is most active in the Ox hour (1-3 am). Key points include Taichong (LR-3, yuan-source), Qimen (LR-14, front-mu of the Liver) and Zhangmen (LR-13, front-mu of the Spleen and meeting point of the zang).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于胞中，下出会阴，沿脊柱后正中线上行，经长强、命门、大椎，至项后风府入络于脑，上巅顶百会，沿前额正中下行至鼻柱、人中，止于上唇龈交。为奇经八脉之一，总督一身之阳经，称阳脉之海，与脑、髓、肾密切相关，主治神志、脊柱及阳气虚衰之证。八脉交会穴为后溪（SI-3）通督脉。要穴有大椎（DU-14）、命门（DU-4）、百会（DU-20）、水沟/人中（DU-26）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Originates in the uterus (or lower dantian), emerges at the perineum at Changqiang (DU-1), and ascends the posterior midline along the spine through Mingmen (DU-4) and Dazhui (DU-14) to Fengfu (DU-16), where it enters the brain; it continues over the vertex at Baihui (DU-20), descends the midline of the forehead and nose, and terminates at Yinjiao (DU-28) on the upper gum. As one of the eight extraordinary vessels the Du Mai governs all the yang channels of the body and is called the 'sea of the yang channels', linking closely with the brain, marrow and Kidney; it treats disorders of consciousness, the spine and collapsed yang. Unlike the twelve regular channels it has no organ-clock hour and does not pertain to a single zang-fu. Its confluent point is Houxi (SI-3). Key points include Dazhui (DU-14), Mingmen (DU-4), Baihui (DU-20) and Renzhong (DU-26).

meridians.descriptionZh: 起于胞中，下出会阴，沿腹胸前正中线上行，经关元、气海、神阙、中脘、膻中，至咽喉、下颌承浆，环口唇，分行至目下承泣。为奇经八脉之一，总任一身之阴经，称阴脉之海，又为胞胎之本，主司妊养，调摄诸阴经气血。八脉交会穴为列缺（LU-7）通任脉。要穴有关元（RN-4）、气海（RN-6）、神阙（RN-8）、中脘（RN-12，胃募、腑会）、膻中（RN-17，心包募、气会）。
meridians.descriptionEn: Originates in the uterus (or lower dantian), emerges at the perineum at Huiyin (RN-1), and ascends the anterior midline through Guanyuan (RN-4), Qihai (RN-6), Shenque (RN-8), Zhongwan (RN-12) and Danzhong (RN-17) to the throat and jaw at Chengjiang (RN-24); it circles the lips and a branch ascends to Chengqi (ST-1) beneath the eye. As one of the eight extraordinary vessels the Ren Mai receives and supports all the yin channels of the body and is called the 'sea of the yin channels', regarded as the root of gestation and nourishment and central to menstruation, pregnancy and fluid balance. Like the Du Mai it has no organ-clock hour and pertains to no single zang-fu. Its confluent point is Lieque (LU-7). Key points include Guanyuan (RN-4), Qihai (RN-6), Zhongwan (RN-12, front-mu of the Stomach and meeting of the fu) and Danzhong (RN-17, front-mu of the Pericardium and meeting of qi).

acupoints.location: 面部，目内眦角稍上方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, in the depression slightly above the inner canthus of the eye
acupoints.depth: 沿眶壁缓慢直刺，不捻转不提插 0.5–1 寸
acupoints.description: 睛明为足太阳膀胱经起始穴，位于目内眦角上方。为治疗一切目疾之要穴。针刺时须沿眶壁缓慢进针，禁止捻转提插。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-1 (Jingming) is the first point of the Bladder channel, located at the inner canthus. It is the foremost point for treating all eye disorders. Needling requires slow insertion along the orbital wall without rotation or lifting-thrusting.

acupoints.location: 面部，眉头凹陷中，眶上切迹处
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, in the depression at the medial end of the eyebrow, at the supraorbital notch
acupoints.depth: 平刺或向眉中斜刺 0.3–0.5 寸
indications: 目视不明、目赤肿痛、迎风流泪
acupoints.description: 攒竹位于眉头凹陷中，善治头痛、眉棱骨痛及目疾。为面瘫配穴之常用穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-2 (Cuanzhu) is located at the medial end of the eyebrow. It is effective for headache, supraorbital pain, and eye disorders, and is commonly used in combinations for facial paralysis.

acupoints.location: 项部，后发际正中直上0.5寸（哑门穴）旁开1.3寸，斜方肌外缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the nape, 1.3 cun lateral to GV-15 (Yamen), in the depression at the lateral border of the trapezius muscle
acupoints.depth: 直刺或微向下斜刺 0.5–0.8 寸
acupoints.description: 天柱位于项部斜方肌外缘，为治疗头项强痛、眩晕的重要穴位。兼清头目，治目痛、鼻塞。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-10 (Tianzhu) is located at the lateral border of the trapezius on the nape. It is an important point for headache, neck stiffness, and dizziness, and also benefits the eyes and nose.

acupoints.location: 背部，第一胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T1
acupoints.description: 大杼为八会穴之骨会，位于第一胸椎旁。善强筋骨，治骨病；兼祛风解表，治外感咳嗽。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-11 (Dazhu) is the influential point for bones among the eight hui-meeting points. It strengthens the sinews and bones and is used for bone diseases, and also dispels wind for exterior conditions with cough.

acupoints.location: 背部，第二胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T2
acupoints.description: 风门位于第二胸椎旁，为祛风解表之要穴。善治外感风邪所致之伤风、咳嗽、荨麻疹。常与肺俞配伍使用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-12 (Fengmen) is located at the level of T2. Its name 'Wind Gate' reflects its primary function of dispelling wind and releasing the exterior. It is essential for common cold, cough, and urticaria, and is often combined with BL-13 (Feishu).

acupoints.location: 第三胸椎棘突下，旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T3
acupoints.description: 肺俞为肺之背俞穴，位于第三胸椎棘突下旁开一寸半。背俞穴直接对应相关脏腑，肺俞可调补肺气、止咳平喘，为治疗一切肺系疾病的基础穴位。临床用于咳嗽、气喘、胸满、盗汗等症，常与中府（肺之募穴）俞募配穴使用。不宜深刺，须防气胸。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-13 (Feishu) is the back-shu point of the Lung, located 1.5 cun lateral to the spinous process of T3. As a back-shu point it directly influences its paired organ, making it fundamental for regulating and supplementing Lung qi, stopping cough, and calming wheezing. It is commonly combined with the front-mu point of the Lung (LU-1 Zhongfu) in shu-mu pairing. Depth of insertion must be carefully controlled to avoid pneumothorax.

acupoints.location: 背部，第四胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T4
acupoints.description: 厥阴俞为心包之背俞穴，位于第四胸椎旁。善宽胸理气，治心痛、心悸、胸闷。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-14 (Jueyinshu) is the back-shu point of the Pericardium, located at the level of T4. It broadens the chest and regulates qi, treating heart pain, palpitations, and chest oppression.

acupoints.location: 背部，第五胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T5
acupoints.description: 心俞为心之背俞穴，位于第五胸椎旁。善宁心安神，治心悸、失眠、癫狂痫。兼宽胸理气，治心痛、胸闷。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-15 (Xinshu) is the back-shu point of the Heart, located at the level of T5. It is the primary point for calming the spirit and treating insomnia, palpitations, and mental disorders. It also broadens the chest for heart pain and chest oppression.

acupoints.location: 背部，第七胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T7
acupoints.description: 膈俞为八会穴之血会，位于第七胸椎旁。善活血化瘀、补血止血，为治一切血病之要穴。兼和胃降逆治呃逆、呕吐。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-17 (Geshu) is the influential point for blood among the eight hui-meeting points, located at the level of T7. It is the foremost point for all blood disorders, including stasis, vacuity, and bleeding. It also harmonizes the stomach for hiccup and vomiting.

acupoints.location: 背部，第九胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T9
acupoints.description: 肝俞为肝之背俞穴，位于第九胸椎旁。善疏肝理气、养血明目，为治肝胆疾患及目疾之要穴。兼熄风镇痉，治癫痫、痉挛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-18 (Ganshu) is the back-shu point of the Liver, located at the level of T9. It courses the liver, nourishes blood, and brightens the eyes. It is essential for liver and gallbladder disorders, eye diseases, and wind conditions such as spasm and epilepsy.

acupoints.location: 背部，第十胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T10
acupoints.description: 胆俞为胆之背俞穴，位于第十胸椎旁。善疏肝利胆、清热化湿，治黄疸、口苦、胁痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-19 (Danshu) is the back-shu point of the Gallbladder, located at the level of T10. It courses the liver, benefits the gallbladder, and clears damp-heat, treating jaundice, bitter taste, and hypochondriac pain.

acupoints.location: 第十一胸椎棘突下，旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T11
acupoints.description: 脾俞为脾之背俞穴，位于第十一胸椎棘突下旁开一寸半。该穴直接调理脾脏功能，健脾益气、和胃化湿，是治疗脾胃疾患的核心背俞穴。临床广泛用于腹胀、腹泻、呕吐、水肿、黄疸等脾失健运之症。灸法尤宜，常与足三里、中脘等穴配伍使用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-20 (Pishu) is the back-shu point of the Spleen, located 1.5 cun lateral to the spinous process of T11. It directly regulates Spleen function, fortifying the Spleen, boosting qi, harmonizing the Stomach, and transforming dampness. It is a core point for treating all Spleen-Stomach transport-and-transformation failures, including abdominal distension, diarrhea, vomiting, edema, and jaundice. Moxibustion is especially effective, often combined with ST-36 and REN-12.

acupoints.location: 背部，第十二胸椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T12
acupoints.description: 胃俞为胃之背俞穴，位于第十二胸椎旁。善和胃健脾、化湿消滞，为治胃脘痛、消化不良之要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-21 (Weishu) is the back-shu point of the Stomach, located at the level of T12. It harmonizes the stomach and fortifies the spleen, and is a key point for stomach pain and digestive disorders.

acupoints.location: 腰部，第一腰椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the lower back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of L1
acupoints.description: 三焦俞为三焦之背俞穴，位于第一腰椎旁。善通调水道、利水消肿，治水肿、小便不利。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-22 (Sanjiaoshu) is the back-shu point of the Triple Burner, located at the level of L1. It regulates the water passages and treats edema, urinary difficulty, and digestive disorders.

acupoints.location: 第二腰椎棘突下，旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of L2
acupoints.description: 肾俞为肾之背俞穴，位于第二腰椎棘突下旁开一寸半，是补肾强腰的要穴。临床以益肾助阳、强腰利水为主要功效，广泛用于遗精、阳痿、遗尿、月经不调、腰痛等肾虚诸症。灸法温补效果显著，常与关元、太溪等穴配伍应用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-23 (Shenshu) is the back-shu point of the Kidney, located 1.5 cun lateral to the spinous process of L2. It is the primary back-shu point for boosting the Kidney, assisting yang, strengthening the lumbar region, and disinhibiting water. Clinically essential for seminal emission, impotence, enuresis, menstrual irregularities, and lower back pain. Moxibustion is highly effective at this point and it is frequently combined with REN-4 (Guanyuan) and KI-3 (Taixi).

acupoints.location: 腰部，第四腰椎棘突下旁开1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the lower back, 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of L4
acupoints.description: 大肠俞为大肠之背俞穴，位于第四腰椎旁。善理气调肠，治腹胀、泄泻、便秘；兼治腰腿痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-25 (Dachangshu) is the back-shu point of the Large Intestine, located at the level of L4. It regulates intestinal qi and treats abdominal distension, diarrhea, constipation, and lumbar pain.

acupoints.location: 骶部，骶正中嵴旁1.5寸，平第一骶后孔
acupoints.locationEn: In the sacral region, 1.5 cun lateral to the median sacral crest, at the level of the 1st posterior sacral foramen
acupoints.description: 小肠俞为小肠之背俞穴，位于第一骶椎旁。善通调二便、清热利湿，治泄泻、遗尿、带下。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-27 (Xiaochangshu) is the back-shu point of the Small Intestine, located at the level of S1. It regulates the two lower orifices and clears damp-heat, treating diarrhea, urinary disorders, and vaginal discharge.

acupoints.location: 骶部，骶正中嵴旁1.5寸，平第二骶后孔
acupoints.locationEn: In the sacral region, 1.5 cun lateral to the median sacral crest, at the level of the 2nd posterior sacral foramen
acupoints.description: 膀胱俞为膀胱之背俞穴，位于第二骶椎旁。善通利小便，治小便不利、遗尿；兼强腰脊，治腰骶痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-28 (Pangguangshu) is the back-shu point of the Bladder, located at the level of S2. It is the primary point for freeing urination and treating enuresis, and also strengthens the lumbosacral region.

acupoints.location: 骶部，髂后上棘内下方，第二骶后孔中
acupoints.locationEn: In the sacral region, in the 2nd posterior sacral foramen, inferomedial to the posterior superior iliac spine
acupoints.description: 次髎位于第二骶后孔中，为治疗妇科疾患之要穴，善调经止痛。兼治腰骶痛及泌尿系疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-32 (Ciliao) is located in the 2nd posterior sacral foramen. It is a key point for gynecological disorders, especially dysmenorrhea and irregular menstruation, and also treats lumbosacral pain and urinary disorders.

acupoints.location: 臀部，臀横纹中点
acupoints.locationEn: On the buttock, at the midpoint of the gluteal fold
acupoints.description: 承扶位于臀横纹中点，为治疗腰骶臀腿痛的常用穴。兼治下肢痿痹及痔疾。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-36 (Chengfu) is located at the midpoint of the gluteal fold. It is commonly used for lumbosacral and leg pain, lower limb atrophy, and hemorrhoids.

indications: Contracture Of Tendon In Popliteal Fossa

acupoints.location: 腘横纹外侧端，股二头肌肌腱内缘
acupoints.locationEn: At the lateral end of the popliteal crease, on the medial border of the tendon of biceps femoris
acupoints.description: 委阳为三焦之下合穴，位于腘横纹外侧端。善通调水道，治小便不利；兼舒筋活络，治腰背及膝部疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-39 (Weiyang) is the lower he-sea point of the Triple Burner, located at the lateral end of the popliteal crease. It regulates the water passages for urinary disorders and relaxes the sinews for lumbar and knee conditions.

acupoints.location: 腘横纹中点，当股二头肌腱与半腱肌腱的中间
acupoints.locationEn: Midpoint of the popliteal crease, between the tendons of biceps femoris and semitendinosus
acupoints.depth: 直刺，或三棱针点刺出血 1–1.5 寸
acupoints.description: 委中为足太阳膀胱经合穴及膀胱之下合穴，亦属四总穴之一，有“腰背委中求”之训。该穴长于舒筋通络、清热凉血，为治疗腰背疼痛的要穴，兼治下肢痿痹、腹痛吐泻及暑热疔疮等症。三棱针点刺放血为其特色刺法。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-40 (Weizhong) is the he-sea point and lower he-sea point of the Bladder channel, and one of the four command points ("for the back and lumbus, take Weizhong"). It excels at relaxing the sinews and freeing the connecting vessels, as well as cooling the blood and draining heat. It is the primary point for lumbar and back pain, and three-edged needle pricking to bleed is its characteristic technique, making it clinically versatile for both musculoskeletal and heat-toxin conditions.

acupoints.location: 背部，第四胸椎棘突下旁开3寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, 3 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of T4
acupoints.description: 膏肓俞位于第四胸椎旁开3寸，为治疗一切虚损性疾病之要穴。灸之尤佳，善补益肺肾、扶正培元。古有'膏肓能主百病'之说。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-43 (Gaohuangshu) is located 3 cun lateral to T4. It is one of the most important points for treating all consumptive and vacuity conditions. Moxibustion is particularly effective here. The ancients said 'Gaohuang governs the hundred diseases.'

acupoints.location: 骶部，第四骶椎棘突下旁开3寸
acupoints.locationEn: In the sacral region, 3 cun lateral to the median sacral crest, at the level of the 4th sacral vertebra
acupoints.description: 秩边位于第四骶椎旁开3寸，为治疗腰骶痛、坐骨神经痛之要穴。兼通利二便，治小便不利及痔疾。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-54 (Zhibian) is located 3 cun lateral to the sacrum at S4. It is a key point for lumbosacral pain and sciatica, and also benefits the two lower orifices for urinary and rectal disorders.

acupoints.location: 小腿后面正中，委中与昆仑之间，腓肠肌两肌腹交界处下方尖角凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the posterior midline of the lower leg, between BL-40 (Weizhong) and BL-60 (Kunlun), in the depression below the bellies of the gastrocnemius muscle when the leg is extended or the heel is raised
acupoints.description: 承山位于小腿后面正中，腓肠肌肌腹下方。善舒筋活络，为治疗腿部转筋、疼痛之要穴。又为治痔之经验穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-57 (Chengshan) is located on the posterior midline of the lower leg. It is the principal point for calf cramps and leg pain, and a key empirical point for treating hemorrhoids.

acupoints.location: 小腿后面，外踝尖上7寸，承山穴外下方1寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the posterior aspect of the lower leg, 7 cun above the tip of the lateral malleolus, 1 cun inferolateral to BL-57 (Chengshan)
acupoints.description: 飞扬为足太阳膀胱经络穴，联络足少阴肾经。善疏经通络、清头明目，治头痛、目眩、鼻衄。兼治腰腿痛及痔疾。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-58 (Feiyang) is the luo-connecting point of the Bladder channel, linking to the Kidney channel. It frees the channels and clears the head, treating headache, dizziness, and nosebleed, as well as lumbar pain and hemorrhoids.

acupoints.location: 足部外踝后方，外踝尖与跟腱之间凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the foot, in the depression between the tip of the lateral malleolus and the Achilles tendon
acupoints.description: 昆仑为足太阳膀胱经经穴，五行属火，列入马丹阳天星十二穴。善舒筋活络，治头项强痛、腰骶痛、坐骨神经痛。孕妇慎用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-60 (Kunlun) is the jing-river point of the Bladder channel, attributed to Fire, and one of Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. It relaxes sinews and frees the channels, treating headache, neck stiffness, lumbosacral pain, and sciatica. Contraindicated during pregnancy.

acupoints.location: 足外侧部，外踝直下方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the foot, in the depression directly below the lateral malleolus
acupoints.description: 申脉为八脉交会穴之一，通于阳跷脉，与后溪（SI-3）相配。善调阳跷脉之气，治失眠（多寐者泻申脉、补照海）、癫痫。兼舒筋活络，治腰腿及足踝痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-62 (Shenmai) is one of the Eight Confluent points, connecting to the Yang Qiao Mai (Yang Motility Vessel), and is classically paired with SI-3 (Houxi). It regulates the Yang Qiao Mai for insomnia and epilepsy. It is also used for headache, dizziness, and musculoskeletal pain of the lower limb.

acupoints.location: 足小趾外侧趾甲角旁约0.1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the little toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail
acupoints.description: 至阴为足太阳膀胱经井穴，五行属金。为矫正胎位之经验穴，灸之尤效。兼清头目，治头痛、目痛、鼻塞。
acupoints.descriptionEn: BL-67 (Zhiyin) is the jing-well point of the Bladder channel, attributed to Metal. It is the renowned empirical point for correcting fetal malpresentation, primarily using moxibustion. It also clears the head and eyes.

acupoints.location: 会阴部，男性在阴囊根部与肛门连线的中点，女性在大阴唇后联合与肛门连线的中点
acupoints.locationEn: In the perineum, at the midpoint between the anus and the root of the scrotum in males, or the midpoint between the anus and the posterior labial commissure in females
acupoints.description: 会阴为任脉起始穴，任脉、督脉、冲脉三脉之交会穴。位于前后阴之间，为人体阴气之总汇。善醒神开窍，可用于溺水窒息等急症；亦善治下焦疾患，如阴痒、痔疮、小便不利等。因位置特殊，临床应用须注意患者隐私及严格消毒。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-1 (Huiyin) is the starting point of the Ren Mai (Conception Vessel) and the meeting point of the Ren, Du, and Chong vessels. Located in the perineum, it is a convergence of yin qi. It can resuscitate consciousness in drowning and asphyxia emergencies, and treats perineal disorders including hemorrhoids, genital itching, and urinary difficulty. Strict asepsis and patient privacy must be maintained.

acupoints.location: 下腹部，前正中线上，耻骨联合上缘中点处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, at the midpoint of the upper border of the pubic symphysis
acupoints.description: 曲骨为任脉与足厥阴肝经交会穴，位于耻骨联合上缘。善通利小便，为治疗泌尿系统疾患的要穴。兼能温肾壮阳、调经止带，治疗生殖系统疾患。针刺前须嘱患者排空膀胱。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-2 (Qugu) is a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Foot Jueyin (Liver) channel, located at the upper border of the pubic symphysis. It is a primary point for urinary disorders including retention, incontinence, and enuresis, and treats reproductive disorders such as impotence and menstrual irregularity. The bladder must be emptied before needling.

acupoints.location: 下腹部，前正中线上，脐中下4寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, 4 cun below the center of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 中极为膀胱之募穴，任脉与足三阴经交会穴。作为膀胱募穴，为诊治膀胱腑证的首选穴，善通利小便。又为足三阴交会穴，兼调肝脾肾三脏，广泛用于泌尿生殖系统疾患，包括月经不调、痛经、遗精及不孕。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-3 (Zhongji) is the front-mu collecting point of the Bladder and a meeting point of the Ren Mai with the three foot yin channels. As the Bladder mu point, it is the foremost point for bladder disorders and urinary dysfunction. Its intersection with the three yin channels extends its efficacy to gynecological and reproductive disorders including dysmenorrhea, infertility, and seminal emission.

acupoints.location: 脐下3寸，前正中线上
acupoints.locationEn: 3 cun below the umbilicus, on the anterior midline
indications: 阳痿，早泄，月经不调，不孕
acupoints.description: 关元位于脐下三寸，为任脉与足三阴经交会穴，又是小肠之募穴。该穴培元固本、温肾壮阳、补益气血，为强壮保健要穴。临床广泛应用于肾虚阳衰之阳痿、不孕、遗尿等生殖泌尿系统疾患，以及一切虚损性疾病。灸法效果尤佳。孕妇慎用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-4 (Guanyuan) lies on the anterior midline 3 cun below the umbilicus and is the front-mu point of the Small Intestine as well as the crossing point of the three foot yin channels with the Conception Vessel. It cultivates the source, secures the root, and warms Kidney yang. It is one of the most powerful points for supplementing original qi, treating reproductive and urogenital vacuity conditions, and reversing general exhaustion. Moxibustion at this point is particularly effective.

acupoints.location: 下腹部，前正中线上，脐中下2寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, 2 cun below the center of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 石门为三焦之募穴。善通调三焦、理气利水，主治水肿、腹痛及泄泻。古代文献有「石门针之不孕」的记载，故孕妇禁针，临床使用须审慎。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-5 (Shimen) is the front-mu collecting point of the San Jiao (Triple Burner). It regulates the Triple Burner, rectifies qi, and disinhibits water for edema, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. CAUTION: classical texts warn that needling this point may cause infertility; it is contraindicated in pregnancy.

acupoints.location: 脐下1.5寸，前正中线上
acupoints.locationEn: 1.5 cun below the umbilicus, on the anterior midline
acupoints.description: 气海位于脐下一寸半，为任脉穴，其名“气海”意为一身之气汇聚之处。该穴益气助阳、调经固经，是治疗气虚、阳虚以及妇科经带疾病的重要穴位。临床常与关元配伍使用，灸治效果尤为突出，对虚脱、气陷等急危重症亦有回阳固脱之功。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-6 (Qihai), the "Sea of Qi," is located 1.5 cun below the umbilicus on the Conception Vessel. Its name reflects its status as the gathering place of the body's qi. It boosts qi and assists yang, making it a key point for all qi vacuity and yang vacuity conditions. Frequently combined with REN-4 (Guanyuan) and treated with moxibustion, it is also used for menstrual irregularities, prostration, and collapse of qi.

acupoints.location: 腹中部，脐中央
acupoints.locationEn: In the center of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 神阙位于脐中央，为任脉穴。该穴禁针，以灸法（隔盐灸、隔姜灸）为主要治疗手段。功善温阳救逆、利水固脱，为急救回阳第一要穴，常用于中风脱证、四肢厥冷等阳气暴脱危症。同时用于久泻久痢、脱肛、水肿等慢性虚寒疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-8 (Shenque), the "Spirit Tower Gate," is located at the center of the umbilicus on the Conception Vessel. Needling is strictly prohibited; treatment is exclusively by moxibustion, classically through a layer of salt or ginger. It is the premier emergency point for warming yang and rescuing from counterflow collapse (yang desertion), used for wind stroke with prostration and reversal cold of the limbs. It is also used for chronic diarrhea, dysentery, rectal prolapse, and edema.

acupoints.location: 上腹部，前正中线上，脐中上1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 1 cun above the center of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 水分位于脐上1寸，穴名「水分」直指其分清泌浊、利水消肿之功。为治疗水肿、腹水的要穴，善通调水道、分利小便。灸治水肿效果尤佳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-9 (Shuifen) is located 1 cun above the umbilicus. Its name ("Water Divide") directly indicates its function of separating the clear from the turbid and regulating water metabolism. It is a primary point for edema, ascites, and urinary difficulty. Moxibustion is particularly effective for water retention.

acupoints.location: 上腹部，前正中线上，脐中上2寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 2 cun above the center of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 下脘位于脐上2寸，为任脉与足太阴脾经交会穴。与中脘（REN-12）、上脘（REN-13）合称「三脘」，三穴分治胃之上中下部疾患。下脘善和胃消食、降逆止呕，主治食积不化、胃痛腹胀。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-10 (Xiawan) is located 2 cun above the umbilicus, a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Foot Taiyin (Spleen) channel. Together with REN-12 (Zhongwan) and REN-13 (Shangwan), it forms the "Three Epigastric Points." It harmonizes the Stomach and disperses food stagnation, treating indigestion, stomach pain, and vomiting.

acupoints.location: 脐上4寸，前正中线上
acupoints.locationEn: 4 cun above the umbilicus, on the anterior midline
specialCategories: 手太阳少阳足阳明任脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 中脘位于脐上四寸，为胃之募穴、腑会穴，又是手太阳小肠经、手少阳三焦经、足阳明胃经与任脉的交会穴。该穴和胃健脾、降逆利水，为治疗一切胃腑疾病的首要穴位，临床用于胃痛、腹胀、呕吐、泄泻及黄疸等消化系统疾患，针灸皆宜。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-12 (Zhongwan) is the front-mu point of the Stomach and the hui-meeting point of the fu organs, located on the anterior midline 4 cun above the umbilicus. It is also the crossing point of the Small Intestine, Triple Burner, and Stomach channels with the Conception Vessel. As the primary point for all fu-organ disorders, it harmonizes the Stomach, fortifies the Spleen, and downbears counterflow. It is indispensable for epigastric pain, distension, vomiting, diarrhea, and jaundice.

acupoints.location: 上腹部，前正中线上，脐中上5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 5 cun above the center of the umbilicus
specialCategories: 任脉与足阳明手太阳交会穴
acupoints.description: 上脘位于脐上5寸，为任脉与足阳明、手太阳交会穴。与中脘、下脘合称「三脘」。上脘主治胃之上部疾患，善和胃降逆、化痰宁神。为治疗呕吐、呃逆的要穴，兼治痰浊型癫痫。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-13 (Shangwan) is located 5 cun above the umbilicus, a meeting point of the Ren Mai, Foot Yangming, and Hand Taiyang channels. It treats the upper portion of the Stomach, harmonizing counterflow to stop vomiting and hiccup. It also transforms phlegm for epilepsy of the phlegm-turbidity type.

acupoints.location: 上腹部，前正中线上，脐中上6寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 6 cun above the center of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 巨阙为心之募穴，位于脐上6寸。作为心之募穴，善宁心安神，为治疗心痛、心悸、癫狂的首选募穴。兼治上消化道疾患，如呕吐呃逆。穴名「巨阙」意为「大剑」，形容其守护心脏之重要性。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-14 (Juque) is the front-mu collecting point of the Heart. As the Heart mu point, it is the primary point for diagnosing and treating Heart disorders: heart pain, palpitations, and chest oppression. It also calms the spirit for mania and epilepsy, and treats upper GI symptoms. Its name ("Great Tower Gate") evokes its role as guardian of the Heart. Avoid deep needling due to the superior liver margin.

acupoints.location: 上腹部，前正中线上，脐中上7寸，剑突下0.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the upper abdomen, on the anterior midline, 7 cun above the center of the umbilicus, 0.5 cun below the xiphoid process
acupoints.description: 鸠尾为任脉络穴，位于剑突下。穴名「鸠尾」因剑突形似鸠（斑鸠）之尾而得名。善宽胸化痰、安神定志，为治疗胸闷、癫痫及呕吐的要穴。作为络穴，联络督脉，调和全身阴阳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-15 (Jiuwei) is the luo-connecting point of the Ren Mai, located below the xiphoid process. Named for the dove-tail shape of the xiphoid, it broadens the chest, transforms phlegm, and calms the spirit. It treats chest oppression, epilepsy, and vomiting. As the Ren Mai luo point, it connects to the Du Mai, harmonizing overall yin-yang balance.

acupoints.location: 胸部，前正中线上，平第四肋间隙，两乳头连线的中点
acupoints.locationEn: On the chest, on the anterior midline, at the level of the 4th intercostal space, at the midpoint of the line connecting the two nipples
specialCategories: 任脉与足太阴少阴交会穴
acupoints.description: 膻中为心包之募穴，八会穴之气会，任脉与足太阴、足少阴交会穴。又称「气海」（上气海），为宗气汇聚之处。作为气会，统治一切气机失调疾患。临床以宽胸理气、止咳平喘见长，为胸闷、心痛、咳喘的要穴。兼能通乳，治疗产后乳少。为胸部最重要的腧穴之一。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-17 (Danzhong, also known as Shanzhong) is the front-mu collecting point of the Pericardium and the hui-meeting point of qi (one of the eight influential points). Known as the "Upper Sea of Qi," it is where gathering qi (zong qi) converges. As the influential point of qi, it commands all qi disorders throughout the body. It is clinically indispensable for chest oppression, cardiac pain, cough, and wheezing, and is also used to promote lactation. It is one of the most important points on the entire chest.

acupoints.location: 颈部，前正中线上，胸骨上窝中央
acupoints.locationEn: On the neck, on the anterior midline, in the center of the suprasternal fossa
acupoints.depth: 先直刺0.2寸，然后将针尖转向下方，沿胸骨柄后面刺入 0.3–0.5 寸
acupoints.description: 天突为任脉与阴维脉交会穴，位于胸骨上窝。善化痰利咽、宽胸降逆，为治疗咳喘、咽喉肿痛、梅核气及瘿气的要穴。针刺操作须特别小心，先直刺浅入再沿胸骨后壁向下，深部有气管及大血管。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-22 (Tiantu) is a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Yinwei vessel, located in the suprasternal fossa. It is a primary point for throat and respiratory disorders: cough, wheezing, sore throat, plum-pit qi (globus), and goiter. NEEDLING TECHNIQUE requires special care: insert perpendicularly 0.2 cun, then redirect the needle tip downward behind the sternum. The trachea and great vessels lie deep to this point.

acupoints.location: 颈部，前正中线上，喉结上方，舌骨上缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the neck, on the anterior midline, above the Adam's apple, in the depression on the upper border of the hyoid bone
acupoints.depth: 向舌根方向斜刺 0.5–0.8 寸
indications: 舌强不语、暴喑、吞咽困难
acupoints.description: 廉泉为任脉与阴维脉交会穴，位于舌骨上缘。穴名含「清泉」之意，善利喉舌，为治疗舌强不语、失语、吞咽困难的首选穴。尤善治中风后语言障碍。针刺时向舌根方向斜刺。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-23 (Lianquan) is a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Yinwei vessel, located above the hyoid bone. Its name ("Honest Spring") evokes fluid flow, reflecting its function of benefiting the tongue and throat. It is the premier point for speech disorders: post-stroke aphasia, stiff tongue, sudden loss of voice, and difficulty swallowing. Needle obliquely toward the root of the tongue.

acupoints.location: 面部，颏唇沟正中凹陷处
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, in the depression at the center of the mentolabial groove
acupoints.description: 承浆为任脉终止穴，任脉与足阳明交会穴。穴名「承浆」意为承接口中津液。善祛风通络、生津止渴，为治疗口眼歪斜、齿痛及流涎的要穴。任脉至此穴终止，与督脉交会，完成任督循环。
acupoints.descriptionEn: REN-24 (Chengjiang) is the terminal point of the Ren Mai and a meeting point with the Foot Yangming channel. Its name ("Receiving Fluid") indicates its function of engendering fluids. It treats facial paralysis, toothache, drooling, and mouth sores. As the final point of the Conception Vessel, it connects with the Governing Vessel, completing the Ren-Du circuit.

acupoints.location: 目外眦旁0.5寸，眶骨外缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: 0.5 cun lateral to the outer canthus, in the depression on the lateral side of the orbital margin
acupoints.depth: 平刺或向后斜刺 0.3–0.5 寸
specialCategories: 手太阳手足少阳交会穴
acupoints.description: 瞳子髎为足少阳胆经起始穴，手太阳、手足少阳三经交会穴。位于目外眦旁，善治眼目诸疾，为眼科常用穴。临床以祛风明目为主，治疗目赤肿痛、迎风流泪、视物模糊等症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-1 (Tongziliao) is the starting point of the Gallbladder channel and a meeting point of the Hand Taiyang, Hand Shaoyang, and Foot Shaoyang channels. Located beside the outer canthus, it is a primary point for ophthalmological disorders including red painful eyes, lacrimation, blurred vision, and corneal opacity.

acupoints.location: 耳屏间切迹前方，下颌骨髁突后缘，张口时呈凹陷处
acupoints.locationEn: Anterior to the intertragic notch, at the posterior border of the mandibular condyle, in the depression formed when the mouth is open
acupoints.description: 听会为足少阳胆经穴，位于耳前，为治疗耳部疾患的要穴。临床以开窍聪耳、祛风通络见长，主治耳聋、耳鸣、中耳炎等耳疾，兼治牙痛、面瘫。针刺时须嘱患者张口取穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-2 (Tinghui) is a key auricular point of the Gallbladder channel. Located anterior to the ear, it excels at opening the portals to sharpen hearing and is a primary point for deafness, tinnitus, and otitis media. It is also effective for toothache and facial paralysis. The patient must open the mouth during needling.

acupoints.location: 耳尖直上，入发际1.5寸处
acupoints.locationEn: Directly above the ear apex, 1.5 cun within the hairline
acupoints.description: 率谷为足太阳与足少阳交会穴，位于耳上颞区。善治偏头痛，为少阳头痛常用穴，兼能平肝息风、和胃止呕。临床对偏头痛、眩晕耳鸣等少阳经病候疗效尤佳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-8 (Shuaigu) is a meeting point of the Foot Taiyang and Foot Shaoyang channels in the temporal region. It is a primary point for migraine and Shaoyang-type headache, and also treats dizziness, tinnitus, and vomiting. Its location directly above the ear makes it particularly effective for lateral headache patterns.

acupoints.location: 耳后乳突后下方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression posteroinferior to the mastoid process
acupoints.description: 完骨为足太阳与足少阳交会穴，位于乳突后下方。善治风邪上扰所致的头痛、面瘫、项强等症，兼能安神助眠。为头面部疾患的常用配穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-12 (Wangu) is a meeting point of the Foot Taiyang and Foot Shaoyang channels, located behind the mastoid process. It is effective for headache, facial paralysis, stiff neck, and insomnia, treating wind-evil patterns affecting the head and face.

acupoints.location: 前额，瞳孔直上，眉上1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the forehead, 1 cun above the midpoint of the eyebrow, directly above the pupil
acupoints.description: 阳白为足少阳与阳维脉交会穴，位于前额眉上。善治前额头痛及眼目疾患，为面瘫治疗的要穴之一，常透刺鱼腰穴治疗眼睑下垂。临床以祛风明目、通络止痛见长。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-14 (Yangbai) is a meeting point of the Foot Shaoyang and Yangwei vessel, located on the forehead above the eyebrow. It excels at treating frontal headache, eye disorders, and facial paralysis. It is frequently needled with through-insertion toward Yuyao for ptosis of the eyelid.

acupoints.location: 项部，当枕骨之下，胸锁乳突肌与斜方肌上端之间的凹陷处
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression between the upper end of the sternocleidomastoid and the trapezius, below the occipital bone
acupoints.depth: 针尖向鼻尖斜刺 0.8–1.2 寸
acupoints.description: 风池位于项后枕骨下方凹陷中，为足少阳胆经要穴。其名“风池”意为风邪聚积之处，长于平肝息风、祛风解毒、通利官窍。临床广泛用于头痛眩晕、外感风邪、目赤肿痛、鼻渊等头面五官疾患，为治疗内风与外风的通用要穴。深部为延髓，针刺时须严格控制方向和角度。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-20 (Fengchi) lies in the depression between the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles below the occiput — its name, "Wind Pool," reflects its role as a site where wind evil gathers and can be expelled. It levels the Liver, extinguishes wind, and frees the sensory orifices. Clinically it is a primary point for headache, dizziness, wind-strike, eye and nasal disorders, and the common cold. Care must be taken with needling depth and angle, as the medulla oblongata lies deep to this point.

acupoints.location: 大椎穴与肩峰端连线的中点处
acupoints.locationEn: At the midpoint of the line connecting DU-14 (Dazhui) and the acromion
specialCategories: 手足少阳阳维脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 肩井为手足少阳与阳维脉交会穴，位于肩上要处。临床以祛风活络、通经下乳著称。善治颈肩痛、乳疾及难产，为催乳催产要穴。因深部为肺尖，严禁深刺，孕妇禁针。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-21 (Jianjing) is a meeting point of the Hand Shaoyang, Foot Shaoyang, and Yangwei vessel. Located on the shoulder, it is clinically important for neck and shoulder pain, difficult labor, and lactation insufficiency. CAUTION: deep needling is strictly prohibited due to the proximity of the lung apex; contraindicated in pregnancy.

acupoints.location: 乳头直下，第七肋间隙，前正中线旁开4寸
acupoints.locationEn: Directly below the nipple, in the 7th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline
acupoints.description: 日月为胆之募穴，足太阴与足少阳交会穴。以利胆疏肝、降逆和胃见长，为诊治胆腑病证的首选募穴。主治胁痛、胆囊炎、黄疸及呕吐呃逆等症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-24 (Riyue) is the front-mu collecting point of the Gallbladder. As the mu point, it is the primary diagnostic and therapeutic point for Gallbladder disorders including cholecystitis, jaundice, and hypochondriac pain. It also treats vomiting and acid reflux by descending counterflow qi.

acupoints.location: 侧腰部，第十二肋骨游离端下际
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the abdomen, at the lower border of the free end of the 12th rib
acupoints.description: 京门为肾之募穴，位于侧腰第十二肋端。以健脾利水、温肾壮腰见长，为诊治肾腑病证的首选募穴。主治肾炎水肿、小便不利及腰胁疼痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-25 (Jingmen) is the front-mu collecting point of the Kidney. Located at the free end of the 12th rib, it is the primary mu point for Kidney disorders including nephritis, edema, and urinary difficulty, and is effective for lumbar and lateral costal pain.

acupoints.location: 侧腹部，章门穴下方，当第十一肋骨游离端下缘与脐水平线的交点处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral abdomen, at the crossing point of the free end of the 11th rib and the level of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 带脉穴为足少阳与带脉交会穴，以其联系带脉而善调带下诸疾。主治月经不调、赤白带下、疝气等。为妇科常用穴位。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-26 (Daimai) is the meeting point of the Foot Shaoyang and the Dai Mai (Girdle Vessel). It excels at regulating menstruation and treating vaginal discharge, and is a primary point for gynecological conditions including leukorrhea, irregular menstruation, and uterine prolapse.

acupoints.location: 侧卧屈股，股骨大转子高点与骶管裂孔连线的外1/3与内2/3交界处
acupoints.locationEn: With the patient lying on the side with thigh flexed, at the junction of the lateral one-third and medial two-thirds of the line connecting the prominence of the greater trochanter and the sacral hiatus
indications: 髋关节及周围软组织疾病
acupoints.description: 环跳为足少阳与足太阳交会穴，列入马丹阳天星十二穴，位于臀部深处。为治疗腰腿痛及坐骨神经痛的首选穴，其祛风化湿、通经活络之力尤强。临床取穴常令患者侧卧屈膝，针感向下肢放射为佳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-30 (Huantiao) is a meeting point of the Foot Shaoyang and Foot Taiyang channels, and one of Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. It is the paramount point for sciatica and lumbago, located deep in the gluteal region. Needle sensation radiating down the leg indicates optimal stimulation. It powerfully dispels wind-damp and frees the channels for lower limb motor disorders.

acupoints.location: 大腿外侧正中，腘横纹上7寸；直立垂手时，中指尖所及处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral aspect of the thigh, 7 cun above the popliteal crease; where the tip of the middle finger touches when standing with arms hanging
acupoints.description: 风市位于大腿外侧，以直立垂手中指尖触及处取穴著称。善祛风止痒，为治疗全身瘙痒、荨麻疹及下肢风痹的要穴。名中有「风」，寓意其祛风之效。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-31 (Fengshi) is located on the lateral thigh, famously located where the fingertip touches when standing with arms at the sides. Its name ("Wind Market") reflects its powerful wind-dispelling action. It is a key point for generalized itching, urticaria, and lower limb wind-impediment patterns.

acupoints.location: 膝外侧，阳陵泉上3寸，股骨外上髁上方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the knee, 3 cun above GB-34 (Yanglingquan), in the depression above the lateral epicondyle of the femur
indications: 膝关节疼痛、肿胀、屈伸不利
acupoints.description: 膝阳关位于膝外侧，以治膝关节疾患见长。善祛风散寒、利关节止痛，为治疗膝骨性关节炎、膝关节肿痛及屈伸不利的局部要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-33 (Xiyangguan) is located on the lateral knee, above the lateral femoral epicondyle. It is a local point for knee osteoarthritis, knee pain, swelling, and restricted flexion-extension, excelling at dispelling wind-cold from the joint.

acupoints.location: 小腿外侧，腓骨头前下方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the lower leg, in the depression anterior and inferior to the head of the fibula
indications: 肩痛、落枕、腰扭伤（远端取穴）
acupoints.description: 阳陵泉为足少阳胆经合穴、胆之下合穴，八会穴之筋会，列入马丹阳天星十二穴。作为筋会，统治全身筋病，举凡筋脉拘急、关节疼痛均可取用。兼能疏肝利胆、清利湿热，为胁痛、黄疸的要穴。现代临床常用于急性腰扭伤及落枕的远端取穴治疗。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-34 (Yanglingquan) is the he-sea point and lower he-sea point of the Gallbladder, the hui-meeting point of sinews (one of the eight influential points), and one of Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. As the influential point of sinews, it commands all sinew disorders throughout the body. It is equally important for coursing the Liver and Gallbladder to treat hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, and jaundice. In modern practice, it is frequently used as a distal point for acute lumbar sprain and torticollis.

acupoints.location: 小腿外侧，外踝尖上5寸，腓骨前缘
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the lower leg, 5 cun above the tip of the lateral malleolus, on the anterior border of the fibula
acupoints.description: 光明为足少阳胆经络穴。穴名含「光明」之意，善治眼目疾患，为远端治疗目疾的要穴。临床以明目退翳、疏肝理气见长，治疗目痛、夜盲及视力减退。作为络穴，兼治胆经经络病变。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-37 (Guangming) is the luo-connecting point of the Gallbladder channel. Its name ("Bright Light") reflects its primary function of brightening the eyes. It is an important distal point for eye disorders including night blindness, blurred vision, and eye pain. As a luo point, it also addresses Gallbladder channel pathology.

indications: Lateral Aspect Of Low Extremity Pain

acupoints.location: 小腿外侧，外踝尖上3寸，腓骨前缘
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the lower leg, 3 cun above the tip of the lateral malleolus, on the anterior border of the fibula
acupoints.description: 悬钟又名绝骨，为八会穴之髓会，足三阳之大络。作为髓会，统治全身骨髓及脑髓疾患，为中风半身不遂的要穴之一。兼治颈项强痛、落枕及胸胁胀痛。现代研究表明其在治疗骨质疏松及脑血管疾病中有重要价值。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-39 (Xuanzhong, also known as Juegu/"Severed Bone") is the hui-meeting point of marrow (one of the eight influential points) and the great luo of the three foot yang channels. As the influential point of marrow, it governs all bone marrow and brain marrow disorders. It is a critical point for wind-stroke hemiplegia, stiff neck, and is valued in modern practice for osteoporosis and cerebrovascular disease.

acupoints.location: 足外踝前下方，趾长伸肌腱外侧凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: Anterior and inferior to the lateral malleolus, in the depression lateral to the tendon of extensor digitorum longus
acupoints.description: 丘墟为足少阳胆经原穴，位于外踝前下方。作为原穴，能调理胆腑气机，治疗胁痛口苦等胆经实证。同时为踝关节扭伤的局部要穴。原穴候脏腑正气之盛衰，诊断及治疗价值并重。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-40 (Qiuxu) is the yuan-source point of the Gallbladder channel. Located near the lateral malleolus, it regulates Gallbladder qi and is used for hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, and Gallbladder repletion patterns. It is also an important local point for lateral ankle sprains.

acupoints.location: 足背，第四、五跖骨结合部之前方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the dorsum of the foot, in the depression distal to the junction of the 4th and 5th metatarsals
acupoints.description: 足临泣为足少阳胆经输穴，八脉交会穴之一（通于带脉），与外关穴配伍应用。临床以疏肝利胆、通调带脉见长，善治偏头痛、乳疾及月经不调。作为输穴兼八脉交会穴，地位独特，主治范围广泛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-41 (Zulinqi) is the shu-stream point of the Gallbladder channel and one of the eight confluent points of the extraordinary vessels (connecting to the Dai Mai/Girdle Vessel), paired with SJ-5 (Waiguan). It courses the Liver and Gallbladder, regulates the Girdle Vessel, and is clinically important for migraine, breast disorders, and menstrual irregularities.

acupoints.location: 足背，第四、五趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处
acupoints.locationEn: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 4th and 5th toes, proximal to the web margin at the junction of red and white skin
acupoints.description: 侠溪为足少阳胆经荥穴，五行属水。荥穴主治身热，故善清泻少阳胆热，治疗头痛眩晕、目赤耳鸣等胆经热证。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-43 (Xiaxi) is the ying-spring point of the Gallbladder channel, pertaining to water in the five phases. As a ying-spring point, it excels at clearing heat from the channel, treating Gallbladder heat patterns such as headache, dizziness, red eyes, and tinnitus.

acupoints.location: 足第四趾外侧，趾甲根角旁0.1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the 4th toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the toenail
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.2 寸
acupoints.description: 足窍阴为足少阳胆经井穴，五行属金。井穴善清本经热邪、开窍醒神，用于少阳经急症。主治偏头痛、目赤、耳聋及咽痛，点刺出血效果尤佳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: GB-44 (Zuqiaoyin) is the jing-well point of the Gallbladder channel, pertaining to metal in the five phases. As a well point, it powerfully clears channel heat and opens the portals. It is used for acute Shaoyang patterns including migraine, red eyes, deafness, and sore throat. Pricking to bleed is especially effective.

acupoints.location: 尾骨端下，尾骨端与肛门连线的中点处
acupoints.locationEn: Below the tip of the coccyx, at the midpoint of the line connecting the tip of the coccyx and the anus
acupoints.depth: 紧靠尾骨前面斜刺 0.5–1 寸
acupoints.description: 长强为督脉起始穴，亦为督脉络穴。位于尾骨端，督脉之气由此上行。善治肛肠疾患，为治疗痔疮、脱肛、便血的首选穴。兼能安神定志，治疗癫狂。针刺时紧靠尾骨前面斜刺，注意消毒。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-1 (Changqiang) is the starting point and luo-connecting point of the Du Mai (Governing Vessel). Located between the coccyx and anus, it is the foremost point for anorectal disorders including hemorrhoids, rectal prolapse, and bloody stool. It also calms the spirit for mania. Needling should be directed anteriorly along the coccyx with strict asepsis.

acupoints.location: 骶部，正中线上，骶管裂孔中
acupoints.locationEn: On the sacrum, on the midline, in the sacral hiatus
acupoints.description: 腰俞位于骶管裂孔中，为督脉穴。善治腰骶部疼痛及下肢痿痹，兼能调经。骶管裂孔为骶管麻醉的重要标志，临床须准确定位。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-2 (Yaoshu) is located in the sacral hiatus on the midline. It treats lumbosacral pain and lower limb motor disorders, and regulates menstruation. The sacral hiatus is an important anatomical landmark for caudal epidural procedures.

acupoints.location: 腰部，后正中线上，第四腰椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the lumbar spine, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 4th lumbar vertebra
acupoints.description: 腰阳关位于第四腰椎棘突下，为督脉阳气通行之关隘。善壮腰补肾、祛寒除湿，为治疗腰痛及下肢痿痹的重要穴位。灸治效果尤佳，常用于肾阳不足所致的腰膝冷痛、遗精阳痿。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-3 (Yaoyangguan) is located below the L4 spinous process, at a key "gate" for yang qi flow in the lumbar spine. It strengthens the lumbus and supplements the Kidney, treating lumbago, lower limb weakness, impotence, and menstrual irregularity. Moxibustion is particularly effective for Kidney yang vacuity patterns with cold-damp lumbar pain.

acupoints.location: 腰部，第二腰椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: Below the spinous process of L2, on the posterior midline
acupoints.description: 命门位于第二腰椎棘突下正中，为督脉穴。“命门”为生命之门，与肾阳（命门之火）密切相关。该穴温肾壮阳、强腰膝、固精止带，为补益先天之火的核心穴位。临床用于肾阳不足之阳痿、遗精、腰脊疼痛、月经不调等症，灸法尤佳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-4 (Mingmen), the "Gate of Life," is located on the posterior midline below the spinous process of L2 on the Governing Vessel. It is intimately connected with Kidney yang — the "ministerial fire" (ming men zhi huo) that is the root of all yang activity in the body. It warms the Kidney, invigorates yang, and strengthens the lumbar region. It is essential for Kidney yang vacuity presenting as impotence, seminal emission, lumbar pain, and menstrual irregularities. Moxibustion is the preferred treatment method.

acupoints.location: 背部，后正中线上，第九胸椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 9th thoracic vertebra
acupoints.description: 筋缩位于第九胸椎棘突下，穴名寓意「筋脉挛缩」。善舒筋止痉、平肝息风，为治疗癫痫抽搐、脊柱强直的要穴。位近肝俞，故兼治肝气郁结所致诸症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-8 (Jinsuo) is located below the T9 spinous process. Its name ("Sinew Contraction") reflects its function of relaxing spastic sinews. It is a primary point for epilepsy, convulsions, and spinal rigidity. Its proximity to the Liver shu point gives it additional efficacy for Liver qi stagnation.

acupoints.location: 背部，后正中线上，第七胸椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 7th thoracic vertebra
acupoints.description: 至阳位于第七胸椎棘突下，穴名含「阳气至此而极」之意，为背部阳气最盛之处。善利胆退黄、宽胸理气，为治疗黄疸的要穴。兼治胸闷胁痛及背部疼痛。临床常与阳陵泉配伍治疗胆系疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-9 (Zhiyang) is located below the T7 spinous process, where yang qi reaches its zenith in the back. It is a critical point for jaundice (often paired with GB-34), and for broadening the chest to relieve oppression. It also treats hypochondriac pain and back pain.

acupoints.location: 背部，后正中线上，第六胸椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 6th thoracic vertebra
acupoints.description: 灵台位于第六胸椎棘突下，穴名含「灵验高台」之意。善宣肺止咳、清热解毒，治疗咳嗽气喘及疮疡肿毒。为背部督脉穴位之一，兼能宁心安神。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-10 (Lingtai) is located below the T6 spinous process. It diffuses the Lung to stop cough and wheezing, and clears heat to resolve toxin for boils. Its name ("Spirit Platform") also reflects its ability to calm the spirit.

acupoints.location: 背部，后正中线上，第五胸椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 5th thoracic vertebra
acupoints.description: 神道位于第五胸椎棘突下，与心俞穴同一水平。穴名「神道」寓意心神之通道，善宁心安神，为治疗心悸失眠、惊恐不宁的要穴。兼治癫痫及背部疼痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-11 (Shendao) is located below the T5 spinous process, at the level of the Heart shu point. Its name ("Spirit Path") reflects its primary function of calming the spirit. It is an important point for palpitations, insomnia, anxiety, and epilepsy.

acupoints.location: 背部，后正中线上，第三胸椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 3rd thoracic vertebra
acupoints.description: 身柱位于第三胸椎棘突下，穴名含「身体支柱」之意。善宣肺清热、宁神镇痉，为小儿保健灸的重要穴位之一。主治咳喘、癫痫惊风及脊背疼痛。日本针灸界尤重身柱灸，视为小儿百病之要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-12 (Shenzhu) is located below the T3 spinous process. Its name ("Body Pillar") reflects its role as a structural and energetic support for the body. It is important for cough, wheezing, epilepsy, and infantile convulsions. In Japanese acupuncture tradition, it is particularly esteemed as a health-preservation moxibustion point for children.

acupoints.location: 背部，后正中线上，第一胸椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 1st thoracic vertebra
acupoints.description: 陶道位于第一胸椎棘突下，为督脉与足太阳交会穴。善解表清热、截疟退热，为治疗疟疾及外感发热的要穴。兼治骨蒸潮热等虚热证。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-13 (Taodao) is located below the T1 spinous process, a meeting point of the Du Mai and Foot Taiyang channel. It resolves the exterior and clears heat, and is a traditional point for interrupting malaria. It also treats steaming bone tidal fever and headache with stiff neck.

acupoints.location: 第七颈椎棘突下凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: Below the spinous process of the 7th cervical vertebra
specialCategories: 手足三阳与督脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 大椎位于第七颈椎棘突下，为督脉穴，是手足三阳经与督脉的交会穴，故有“诸阳之会”之称。该穴善于解表退热、清心安神，是治疗一切热病的要穴。临床广泛用于外感发热、疟疾、咳嗽气喘等症，灸法亦常用于虚寒性疾患的温阳散寒。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-14 (Dazhui) lies below the spinous process of C7 and is the crossing point of all six hand and foot yang channels with the Governing Vessel — hence its title, "Meeting of All Yang." It is the premier point for resolving the exterior and abating fever in febrile disease, and also for clearing heat in malaria. With moxibustion it can warm yang to treat vacuity-cold patterns. Its unique convergence of all yang channels makes it broadly effective for both repletion-heat and vacuity-cold conditions.

acupoints.location: 项部，后正中线上，第一颈椎（寰椎）棘突下凹陷中，后发际正中直上0.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the nape, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 1st cervical vertebra (atlas), 0.5 cun above the midpoint of the posterior hairline
acupoints.depth: 伏案正坐，向下颌方向缓慢刺入 0.5–1 寸
acupoints.description: 哑门为督脉与阳维脉交会穴，穴名「哑门」直指其善治哑证。为治疗暴喑、舌强不语、聋哑的首选穴，兼治癫狂痫证。因深部为延髓，操作须极为谨慎，严禁深刺及向上斜刺，禁灸。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-15 (Yamen) is a meeting point of the Du Mai and Yangwei vessel. Its name ("Gate of Muteness") indicates its primary function of treating speech disorders: sudden aphonia, stiff tongue, and deaf-mutism. CRITICAL CAUTION: the medulla oblongata lies deep to this point -- needling must be directed toward the mandible, never upward, and depth must not exceed 1 cun. Moxibustion is contraindicated.

acupoints.location: 项部，后发际正中直上1寸，枕外隆凸直下，两侧斜方肌之间凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: 1 cun above the midpoint of the posterior hairline, directly below the external occipital protuberance
acupoints.depth: 向下颌方向缓慢刺入 0.5–1 寸
acupoints.description: 风府为督脉与阳维脉交会穴，位于项后正中枕外隆凸直下。其名“风府”意为风邪入侵之门户，善散风解表、通关开窍。临床用于头痛项强、中风失语、癫狂痫、感冒等风邪上犯之症。深部紧邻延髓，禁深刺，不可大幅度提插，须格外谨慎操作。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-16 (Fengfu), the "Wind Palace," is the crossing point of the Governing Vessel and the Yang Linking Vessel, located directly below the external occipital protuberance. Its name indicates that it is a gateway through which wind evil enters the body. It dissipates wind, resolves the exterior, and opens the orifices. Clinically used for headache, stiff neck, wind stroke with aphasia, and epilepsy. Deep needling is strictly prohibited due to the proximity of the medulla oblongata.

acupoints.location: 头部，后正中线上，风府穴直上1.5寸，枕外隆凸上缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the head, on the posterior midline, 1.5 cun above DU-16 (Fengfu), in the depression on the upper border of the external occipital protuberance
acupoints.description: 脑户位于枕外隆凸上缘，为督脉与足太阳交会穴。穴名「脑户」直指其近脑之位置，善醒脑开窍、息风止痉，为治疗头痛眩晕、癫痫的常用穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-17 (Naohu) is located at the upper border of the external occipital protuberance, a meeting point of the Du Mai and Foot Taiyang channel. Its name ("Brain's Door") reflects its proximity to the brain. It treats headache, dizziness, epilepsy, and eye disorders by arousing the brain and opening the portals.

acupoints.location: 头部前发际正中直上5寸，两耳尖连线中点
acupoints.locationEn: On the midline of the head, 5 cun posterior to the anterior hairline, at the midpoint of a line connecting the apexes of the auricles
acupoints.description: 百会位于头顶正中，为督脉与诸阳经交会穴，“百脉之会”之名体现其统率全身阳气的地位。该穴升阳举陷、醒脑开窍、安神定志，临床常用于治疗头痛眩晕、中风失语、脱肛、子宫脱垂等气陷之证，亦是针灸治疗精神神志疾病的要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-20 (Baihui) sits at the vertex of the head, where the Governing Vessel meets all the yang channels — hence its name, "Hundred Convergences." It is the premier point for raising yang and upbearing the sunken, and for rousing the brain and opening the orifices. Clinically essential for headache, dizziness, wind stroke, aphasia, organ prolapse (rectal, uterine), and spirit-mind disorders including insomnia and poor memory.

acupoints.location: 头部，前正中线上，前发际正中直上1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the head, on the anterior midline, 1 cun directly above the midpoint of the anterior hairline
acupoints.description: 上星位于前发际上1寸，善通鼻窍、清头目，为治疗鼻渊（鼻窦炎）、鼻衄、鼻塞的要穴。兼治前额头痛、目眩及精神疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-23 (Shangxing) is located 1 cun above the anterior hairline. It is a primary point for opening the nasal passages, treating sinusitis, epistaxis, and nasal obstruction. It also clears the head for frontal headache and dizziness.

acupoints.location: 头部，前正中线上，前发际正中直上0.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the head, on the anterior midline, 0.5 cun directly above the midpoint of the anterior hairline
specialCategories: 督脉与足太阳足阳明交会穴
acupoints.description: 神庭位于前发际上0.5寸，为督脉与足太阳、足阳明交会穴。穴名「神庭」寓意「神之宫庭」，善宁神醒脑，为治疗失眠、头痛、癫狂的要穴。兼治鼻部疾患。头皮针常取此穴区域。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-24 (Shenting) is located 0.5 cun above the anterior hairline, a meeting point of the Du Mai, Foot Taiyang, and Foot Yangming channels. Its name ("Spirit Court") reflects its potent spirit-calming function. It is an important point for insomnia, headache, epilepsy, and mania. It is frequently included in scalp acupuncture protocols.

acupoints.location: 面部，鼻尖正中
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, at the tip of the nose
acupoints.depth: 向上斜刺或点刺出血 0.2–0.3 寸
acupoints.description: 素髎位于鼻尖正中，为督脉面部要穴。善通鼻窍、开窍醒神，为治疗鼻部疾患及急救穴位之一。可用于昏迷休克的急救，点刺出血尤能止鼻衄。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-25 (Suliao) is located at the tip of the nose. It opens the nasal portals for nasal obstruction, epistaxis, and sinusitis, and arouses the spirit in emergency situations such as coma and shock. Pricking to bleed is effective for epistaxis. Moxibustion is contraindicated.

acupoints.location: 面部，人中沟上1/3与下2/3交点处
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, at the junction of the upper one-third and lower two-thirds of the philtrum
specialCategories: 督脉与手足阳明交会穴
indications: 昏迷、晕厥、中暑、休克（急救第一要穴）
acupoints.description: 水沟又名人中，为督脉与手阳明、足阳明交会穴，孙思邈十三鬼穴之一。被公认为中医急救第一要穴，位于人中沟上1/3处，为一切昏迷急症的首选穴位。【急救应用】凡遇昏厥、晕倒、中暑、癫痫发作、中风昏迷、溺水急救、新生儿窒息等紧急情况，首选水沟穴。操作方法：以拇指甲掐按或用毫针向上斜刺0.3-0.5寸，用强刺激手法（雀啄泻法），以患者苏醒或眼球湿润为度。如遇心跳骤停，应同时配合现代心肺复苏术。水沟穴急救的机理在于其强烈刺激通过三叉神经传入，兴奋网状激活系统，促使患者苏醒。本穴还善治急性腰扭伤（令患者活动腰部同时针刺），以及癫狂痫证。为历代医家急救必取之穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: DU-26 (Shuigou), commonly known as Renzhong ("Person's Center"), is the single most important emergency acupoint in Chinese medicine. It is a meeting point of the Du Mai, Hand Yangming, and Foot Yangming channels, and one of Sun Simiao's thirteen ghost points. EMERGENCY PROTOCOL: DU-26 is the first-line acupoint for ALL loss-of-consciousness emergencies: syncope, coma, heatstroke, wind-stroke, shock, drowning, epileptic seizure, and neonatal asphyxia. Technique: press firmly with the thumbnail or insert a needle obliquely upward 0.3-0.5 cun using strong reducing stimulation (pecking technique) until the patient regains consciousness or the eyes moisten. In cardiac arrest, combine with modern CPR. The mechanism involves trigeminal nerve afferent stimulation activating the reticular activating system to restore consciousness. Beyond emergency use, DU-26 is also highly effective for acute lumbar sprain (needle while the patient moves the waist) and for mania and epilepsy. It has been the paramount emergency point across all dynasties of Chinese medicine.

acupoints.location: 腋窝正中，腋动脉搏动处
acupoints.locationEn: At the center of the axilla, where the axillary artery pulsates
acupoints.description: 极泉为手少阴心经起始穴，位于腋窝中央。善宽胸理气、宁心安神，治心痛、心悸及上肢疼痛不遂。临床针刺须避开腋动脉，宜避开搏动处取穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-1 (Jiquan) is the starting point of the Heart channel, located at the center of the axilla. It broadens the chest, regulates qi, and calms the heart. It treats heart pain, palpitations, and upper limb pain or paralysis.

acupoints.location: 臂内侧，肘横纹上3寸，肱二头肌内侧沟中
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial aspect of the upper arm, 3 cun above the cubital crease, in the medial groove of the biceps brachii
acupoints.description: 青灵为手少阴心经穴，位于上臂内侧。善通经活络、宽胸止痛，治心痛、肩臂痛及胁痛。临床多与极泉、少海同用以疏通心经上肢经气。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-2 (Qingling) is a point on the Heart channel on the medial upper arm. It frees the channels, broadens the chest, and stops pain. It treats heart pain, shoulder-arm pain, and lateral costal pain.

acupoints.location: 肘横纹内侧端，肱骨内上髁前缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: At the medial end of the cubital crease, in the depression anterior to the medial epicondyle of the humerus
acupoints.description: 少海为手少阴心经合穴，五行属水。善宁心安神、通经活络，治心痛、癫狂及肘臂疾患。临床常与神门、内关相配以宁心定悸。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-3 (Shaohai) is the he-sea point of the Heart channel with the five-phase attribute of water. It calms the heart, quiets the spirit, and frees the channels. It treats heart pain, mania and withdrawal, and elbow-arm disorders.

acupoints.location: 前臂掌面尺侧，尺侧腕屈肌腱桡侧缘，腕横纹上1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the palmar aspect of the forearm, on the radial side of the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease
acupoints.description: 灵道为手少阴心经经穴，五行属金。善宁心安神、利舌开音，治心痛、心悸及暴喑。临床配廉泉、哑门以治中风失语之证。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-4 (Lingdao) is the jing-river point of the Heart channel with the five-phase attribute of metal. It calms the heart, quiets the spirit, and benefits the tongue. It treats heart pain, palpitations, and sudden loss of voice.

acupoints.location: 前臂掌面尺侧，尺侧腕屈肌腱桡侧缘，腕横纹上1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the palmar aspect of the forearm, on the radial side of the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris, 1 cun above the wrist crease
acupoints.description: 通里为手少阴心经络穴，联络手太阳小肠经。善宁心安神、清心降火，治心悸、暴喑及舌强不语。临床为失语失音及心悸之常用穴，多与通里、哑门配伍。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-5 (Tongli) is the luo-connecting point of the Heart channel, connecting to the Small Intestine channel. It calms the heart, quiets the spirit, and clears heart fire. It treats palpitations, sudden loss of voice, and tongue stiffness.

acupoints.location: 前臂掌面尺侧，尺侧腕屈肌腱桡侧缘，腕横纹上0.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the palmar aspect of the forearm, on the radial side of the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris, 0.5 cun above the wrist crease
acupoints.description: 阴郄为手少阴心经郄穴，善养心安神、清热止血。郄穴主急症，本穴尤擅治心痛急发、吐血、盗汗等心阴虚火旺诸症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-6 (Yinxi) is the xi-cleft point of the Heart channel. It nourishes the heart, calms the spirit, and clears heat to stop bleeding. As a xi-cleft point treating acute conditions, it is especially effective for sudden heart pain, hematemesis, and night sweating due to heart yin vacuity with effulgent fire.

acupoints.location: 腕横纹尺侧端，尺侧腕屈肌腱的桡侧凹陷处
acupoints.locationEn: On the wrist crease at the radial side of the tendon of the flexor carpi ulnaris
acupoints.description: 神门为手少阴心经原穴兼输穴，是宁心安神的第一要穴。心主神明，神门直通心气，故对一切心神不宁之症（心悸、失眠、健忘、惊恐、癫狂）均有显著疗效。该穴还能通经活络，用于心经循行部位的疼痛，为针灸治疗心系及精神疾患的核心穴位。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-7 (Shenmen), the "Spirit Gate," is the yuan-source point and shu-stream point of the Heart channel. As the Heart governs the spirit-mind (shen), Shenmen is the single most important point for quieting the Heart and calming the spirit. It is clinically essential for palpitations, insomnia, poor memory, fright, anxiety, and mania. Its name directly conveys its function as the gateway through which the spirit is accessed and settled.

acupoints.location: 手掌面，第四、五掌骨之间，握拳时小指尖所指处
acupoints.locationEn: On the palm, between the 4th and 5th metacarpal bones, where the tip of the little finger rests when a fist is made
acupoints.description: 少府为手少阴心经荥穴，五行属火。善清心泻火、宁心安神，治心悸、胸痛、小便不利及掌中热。临床配劳宫清心泻火，治口舌生疮、心烦失眠。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-8 (Shaofu) is the ying-spring point of the Heart channel with the five-phase attribute of fire. It clears heart fire, calms the heart, and quiets the spirit. It treats palpitations, chest pain, difficult urination, and heat in the palm.

acupoints.location: 手小指末节桡侧，距指甲角0.1寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the little finger, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.1 寸
acupoints.description: 少冲为手少阴心经井穴，五行属木。善清心泻热、开窍醒神，为急救要穴之一。点刺出血治热病昏迷、中风不省人事。
acupoints.descriptionEn: HT-9 (Shaochong) is the jing-well point of the Heart channel with the five-phase attribute of wood. It clears heart heat, opens the orifices, and arouses the spirit. It is one of the key emergency points. Pricking to bleed treats febrile coma and wind-stroke with loss of consciousness.

acupoints.location: 足底部，蜷足时足前部凹陷处，约当足底2、3趾趾缝纹头端与足跟连线的前三分之一与后三分之二交点上
acupoints.locationEn: On the sole, in the depression formed when the foot is in plantar flexion, approximately at the junction of the anterior 1/3 and posterior 2/3 of the line connecting the base of the 2nd and 3rd toes with the heel
acupoints.description: 涌泉为足少阴肾经井穴，位于足底前部凹陷处，为全身最低之穴位。“涌泉”意为肾经经气由此涌出。该穴善苏厥开窍、滋阴降火，为急救要穴之一，用于昏厥、中暑等危急症。亦用于头顶痛、失眠、小儿惊风等症，体现“上病下取”的治疗原则。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-1 (Yongquan), the "Gushing Spring," is the jing-well point of the Kidney channel, located on the sole of the foot — the lowest point on the body. It is where Kidney channel qi first springs forth. As a well point it is powerful for reviving consciousness in emergencies (corpse-like reversal, heatstroke), and for enriching yin and downbearing fire. It treats vertex headache, insomnia, and infantile convulsions, exemplifying the principle of "treating above by selecting below."

acupoints.location: 足内侧，足舟骨粗隆下方，赤白肉际处
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the foot, below the tuberosity of the navicular bone, at the junction of the red and white skin
acupoints.description: 然谷为足少阴肾经荥穴，五行属火。善滋阴清热，治肾阴不足之虚热证。兼调经止血，治月经不调。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-2 (Rangu) is the ying-spring point of the Kidney channel, attributed to Fire. It enriches yin and clears vacuity heat, and regulates menstruation. It is used for kidney yin vacuity patterns with heat signs.

acupoints.location: 内踝尖与跟腱之间凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression between the tip of the medial malleolus and the Achilles tendon
acupoints.description: 太溪为足少阴肾经原穴兼输穴，是补肾益精、滋阴壮阳的代表穴位。肾为先天之本，太溪作为其原穴，可调节肾之阴阳，临床广泛用于肾虚所致的腰痛、耳鸣、头晕、咽痛、齿痛等症。诊脉时太溪脉搏动的有无亦可判断肾气盛衰。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-3 (Taixi) is both the yuan-source point and shu-stream point of the Kidney channel, making it the principal point for supplementing the Kidney in all its aspects — yin, yang, and essence. Because the Kidney is the root of prenatal qi, Taixi is broadly applicable to lumbar pain, tinnitus, dizziness, sore throat, toothache, and cough due to Kidney vacuity. The palpation of the Taixi pulse is also a classical diagnostic indicator of the state of Kidney qi.

acupoints.location: 足内侧，内踝后下方，跟腱附着部内侧前方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the foot, posteroinferior to the medial malleolus, in the depression anterior to the medial attachment of the Achilles tendon
acupoints.description: 大钟为足少阴肾经络穴，联络足太阳膀胱经。善补肾益精、强腰壮骨，治肾虚腰痛、足跟痛。兼治咳喘（肾不纳气）。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-4 (Dazhong) is the luo-connecting point of the Kidney channel, linking to the Bladder channel. It supplements the kidney, strengthens the lumbar region, and treats heel pain. It is also used for asthma and cough due to kidney qi failing to grasp qi.

acupoints.location: 足内侧，太溪直下1寸，跟骨结节内侧凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the foot, 1 cun directly below KI-3 (Taixi), in the depression of the medial side of the calcaneal tuberosity
acupoints.description: 水泉为足少阴肾经郄穴。善调经止血，治月经不调、痛经、经闭。兼通利小便。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-5 (Shuiquan) is the xi-cleft point of the Kidney channel. It regulates menstruation and stops bleeding, treating dysmenorrhea, irregular menstruation, and amenorrhea. It also frees urination.

acupoints.location: 足内侧，内踝尖下方凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the foot, in the depression below the tip of the medial malleolus
acupoints.description: 照海为八脉交会穴之一，通于阴跷脉，与列缺（LU-7）相配。善滋阴清热、利咽喉，治咽喉干痛为首选穴。兼调阴跷脉之气，治失眠（不寐者补照海、泻申脉）。又调经治带，为妇科常用穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-6 (Zhaohai) is one of the Eight Confluent points, connecting to the Yin Qiao Mai (Yin Motility Vessel), classically paired with LU-7 (Lieque). It is the foremost point for sore dry throat due to yin vacuity, and regulates the Yin Qiao Mai for insomnia (supplement KI-6, drain BL-62). It also regulates menstruation and treats gynecological disorders.

acupoints.location: 小腿内侧，太溪直上2寸，跟腱前缘
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the lower leg, 2 cun directly above KI-3 (Taixi), on the anterior border of the Achilles tendon
acupoints.description: 复溜为足少阴肾经经穴，五行属金。善补肾益阴、利水消肿，为治水肿之要穴。又为止汗之经验穴（自汗盗汗皆可）。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-7 (Fuliu) is the jing-river point of the Kidney channel, attributed to Metal. It supplements the kidney, disinhibits water, and disperses edema. It is also a key empirical point for stopping both spontaneous and night sweating.

acupoints.location: 腘窝内侧，半腱肌肌腱与半膜肌肌腱之间
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the popliteal fossa, between the tendons of semitendinosus and semimembranosus muscles
acupoints.description: 阴谷为足少阴肾经合穴，五行属水。善补肾益阴，治遗精、阳痿；兼清利下焦湿热，治小便不利、妇科疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-10 (Yingu) is the he-sea point of the Kidney channel, attributed to Water. It supplements the kidney and boosts yin for seminal emission and impotence, and clears lower jiao damp-heat for urinary and gynecological disorders.

acupoints.location: 胸部，第二肋间隙，前正中线旁开2寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the chest, in the 2nd intercostal space, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
acupoints.description: 神藏位于第二肋间隙，前正中线旁开2寸。善宽胸降逆、止咳平喘，治咳嗽、气喘、胸闷。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-25 (Shencang) is located in the 2nd intercostal space. It broadens the chest and stops cough and asthma. It is used for chest oppression, chest pain, and respiratory conditions.

acupoints.location: 胸部，锁骨下缘，前正中线旁开2寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the chest, in the depression on the lower border of the clavicle, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
acupoints.description: 俞府为足少阴肾经末穴，位于锁骨下缘。善宽胸降逆、止咳平喘，治肾不纳气之咳喘。兼和胃降逆。
acupoints.descriptionEn: KI-27 (Shufu) is the final point of the Kidney channel, located below the clavicle. It broadens the chest and stops cough and asthma, especially when the kidneys fail to grasp qi. It also harmonizes the stomach.

acupoints.location: 手食指末节桡侧，距指甲角0.1寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the index finger, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.1 寸
acupoints.description: 商阳为手阳明大肠经井穴，五行属金。善清热解表、利咽消肿、开窍醒神，可治热病、咽痛、牙痛及中风急救。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-1 (Shangyang) is the jing-well point of the Large Intestine channel with the five-phase attribute of metal. It clears heat, resolves the exterior, benefits the throat, reduces swelling, and opens the orifices. It treats febrile disease, sore throat, toothache, and is used for emergency treatment of wind-stroke.

acupoints.location: 手食指桡侧，第二掌指关节前凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the index finger, in the depression distal to the 2nd metacarpophalangeal joint
acupoints.description: 二间为手阳明大肠经荥穴，五行属水。善清热解表、利咽消肿，为治牙痛、咽痛之常用穴。临床多以泻法为主，配合谷治阳明火盛之头面疾患。
