acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-2 (Erjian) is the ying-spring point of the Large Intestine channel with the five-phase attribute of water. It clears heat, resolves the exterior, and benefits the throat. It is commonly used for toothache and sore throat.

acupoints.location: 手食指桡侧，第二掌指关节后凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the index finger, in the depression proximal to the 2nd metacarpophalangeal joint
acupoints.description: 三间为手阳明大肠经输穴，五行属木。善清热利咽、通腑泄热，治咽痛、牙痛、腹胀及手部肿痛。临床常与合谷、曲池同用以泄阳明郁热。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-3 (Sanjian) is the shu-stream point of the Large Intestine channel with the five-phase attribute of wood. It clears heat, benefits the throat, and frees the bowels to discharge heat. It treats sore throat, toothache, abdominal distension, and swelling of the hand.

acupoints.location: 手背第一、二掌骨间，约平第二掌骨桡侧的中点处
acupoints.locationEn: On the dorsum of the hand between the 1st and 2nd metacarpal bones, at the midpoint of the radial side of the 2nd metacarpal
indications: 头痛、目赤肿痛、鼻衄、齿痛
acupoints.description: 合谷为手阳明大肠经原穴，四总穴之一，素有“面口合谷收”之称，为全身最常用穴位之一。该穴镇痛力强，善治头面五官诸疾；又能解表泄热，广泛应用于外感发热；与太冲配伍称“四关穴”，调畅全身气机。孕妇慎用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-4 (Hegu) is the yuan-source point of the Large Intestine channel and one of the four command points ("for the face and mouth, take Hegu"). Renowned for its powerful analgesic effect, it is among the most frequently needled points in clinical practice. It excels at treating disorders of the head, face, and sense organs, and is a key point for resolving the exterior in febrile disease. Paired with LR-3 (Taichong) as the "four gates," it powerfully regulates qi flow throughout the body. Contraindicated for vigorous stimulation in pregnancy.

acupoints.location: 腕背横纹桡侧端，拇短伸肌腱与拇长伸肌腱之间凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the dorsal wrist crease, in the depression between the tendons of extensor pollicis brevis and extensor pollicis longus (anatomical snuffbox)
acupoints.description: 阳溪为手阳明大肠经经穴，五行属火。位于腕背鼻烟壶处，善清热散风、利咽止痛，治头痛、耳鸣、咽痛及手腕疼痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-5 (Yangxi) is the jing-river point of the Large Intestine channel with the five-phase attribute of fire. Located in the anatomical snuffbox, it clears heat, disperses wind, and benefits the throat. It treats headache, tinnitus, sore throat, and wrist pain.

acupoints.location: 前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，腕横纹上3寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the dorsal forearm, 3 cun above the wrist crease, on the line connecting LI-5 and LI-11
acupoints.description: 偏历为手阳明大肠经络穴，联络手太阴肺经。善疏风解表、利水消肿，治鼻衄、耳鸣、水肿及手臂疼痛。临床以泻法通络消肿，兼调水液输布。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-6 (Pianli) is the luo-connecting point of the Large Intestine channel, connecting to the Lung channel. It courses wind, resolves the exterior, disinhibits water, and reduces swelling. It treats nosebleed, tinnitus, edema, and arm pain.

acupoints.location: 前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，腕横纹上5寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the dorsal forearm, 5 cun above the wrist crease, on the line connecting LI-5 and LI-11
acupoints.description: 温溜为手阳明大肠经郄穴，善清热解毒、消肿止痛。郄穴主急症，本穴尤擅治头面急性肿痛及肩臂疼痛。临床多用于丹毒、颐痈急症及肩周炎。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-7 (Wenliu) is the xi-cleft point of the Large Intestine channel. Xi-cleft points treat acute conditions, and this point excels at clearing heat, resolving toxins, and reducing swelling. It is particularly effective for acute swelling and pain of the head and face, and shoulder-arm pain.

acupoints.location: 前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，曲池下4寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the dorsal forearm, 4 cun below LI-11, on the line connecting LI-5 and LI-11
acupoints.description: 下廉为手阳明大肠经穴，善调理肠胃、通经活络，治腹痛腹胀及肘臂疼痛。与足三里合用可增强理气消胀之效，亦为上肢痹痛之辅穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-8 (Xialian) is a point on the Large Intestine channel that regulates the intestines and stomach and frees the channels. It treats abdominal pain, distension, and elbow-arm pain. It is often combined with ST-36 to strengthen qi regulation and serves as an adjunct point for upper limb painful obstruction.

acupoints.location: 前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，曲池下3寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the dorsal forearm, 3 cun below LI-11, on the line connecting LI-5 and LI-11
acupoints.description: 上廉为手阳明大肠经穴，善调理肠胃、通经止痛，治腹痛泄泻、肩臂痛及上肢活动不利。临床与手三里、曲池同用以治上肢痿痹。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-9 (Shanglian) is a point on the Large Intestine channel. It regulates the intestines and stomach, frees the channels, and stops pain. It treats abdominal pain, diarrhea, shoulder-arm pain, and hemiplegia of the upper limb.

acupoints.location: 前臂背面桡侧，阳溪与曲池连线上，曲池下2寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the dorsal forearm, 2 cun below LI-11, on the line connecting LI-5 and LI-11
acupoints.description: 手三里为手阳明大肠经穴，善调理肠胃、通经活络、消肿止痛，为治疗上肢疼痛麻痹之常用穴。因位近曲池，两穴常相配增强调肠胃、通经络之力。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-10 (Shousanli) is a point on the Large Intestine channel. It regulates the intestines and stomach, frees the channels, and reduces swelling. It is a commonly used point for upper limb pain and paralysis. Lying close to LI-11 (Quchi), the two are frequently paired to enhance regulation of the intestines and the freeing of channels.

acupoints.location: 肘横纹外侧端，屈肘时当尺泽与肱骨外上髁连线中点
acupoints.locationEn: At the lateral end of the elbow crease, midway between LU-5 and the lateral epicondyle of the humerus when the elbow is flexed
acupoints.description: 曲池为手阳明大肠经合穴，位于肘横纹外侧端。该穴清热和营、降逆活络，为治疗热病及上肢疾患的要穴。临床广泛用于热病发热、咽喉肿痛、上肢不遂及皮肤病（瘾疹、瘰疬），是清泻阳明经热的代表穴位。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-11 (Quchi) is the he-sea point of the Large Intestine channel, located at the lateral end of the elbow crease. It clears heat and harmonizes the nutritive level, making it a principal point for febrile disease, sore swollen throat, and upper-limb motor impairment. As a he-sea point of the yangming channel, it is especially effective for clearing yangming heat, and is widely used for dermatological conditions including urticaria and scrofula.

acupoints.location: 臂外侧，曲池上方1寸，肱骨外上髁外缘
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral aspect of the upper arm, 1 cun above LI-11, on the lateral border of the lateral epicondyle of the humerus
acupoints.description: 肘髎为手阳明大肠经穴，位于曲池穴上方。善舒筋活络、消肿止痛，主治肘臂疼痛、挛急及上肢不遂。临床多与曲池、手三里同用以治网球肘及肘部风寒痹痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-12 (Zhouliao) is a point on the Large Intestine channel above LI-11. It relaxes the sinews, quickens the network vessels, and reduces swelling. It treats elbow-arm pain, contracture, and hemiplegia of the upper limb.

acupoints.location: 臂外侧，曲池上3寸，肱骨外侧缘
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral aspect of the upper arm, 3 cun above LI-11, on the lateral border of the humerus
acupoints.description: 手五里为手阳明大肠经穴，善通经活络、理气散结，治肘臂疼痛、瘰疬等症。临床配肘髎、曲池可疏通手阳明经气。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-13 (Shouwuli) is a point on the Large Intestine channel. It frees the channels, regulates qi, and disperses binds. It treats elbow-arm pain and scrofula. It is commonly paired with LI-12 and LI-11 to course qi through the Hand Yangming channel.

acupoints.location: 臂外侧，三角肌下端，曲池上7寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral aspect of the upper arm, at the lower end of the deltoid muscle, 7 cun above LI-11
acupoints.depth: 直刺或向上斜刺 0.5–1 寸
specialCategories: 手阳明与手少阳交会穴
acupoints.description: 臂臑为手阳明大肠经穴，与手少阳经交会。善通经活络、理气消痰，主治肩臂痛、上肢不遂及瘰疬。为肩臂疼痛与瘰疬并治之经验效穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-14 (Binao) is a point on the Large Intestine channel that intersects with the Triple Burner channel. It frees the channels, regulates qi, and resolves phlegm. It treats shoulder-arm pain, upper limb paralysis, and scrofula.

acupoints.location: 肩峰前下方，三角肌上部，臂外展时呈现凹陷处
acupoints.locationEn: Anteroinferior to the acromion, in the depression that appears when the arm is abducted, at the anterior portion of the deltoid
acupoints.depth: 直刺或向下斜刺 0.8–1.5 寸
specialCategories: 手阳明与阳蹻脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 肩髃为手阳明大肠经穴，与阳蹻脉交会。为治疗肩关节疾患之首选穴，善通经活络、疏散风热，治肩臂痛、上肢不遂及皮肤瘾疹。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-15 (Jianyu) is a point on the Large Intestine channel that intersects with the Yang Qiao vessel. It is the primary point for shoulder joint disorders. It frees the channels, disperses wind-heat, and treats shoulder-arm pain, upper limb paralysis, and urticaria.

acupoints.location: 肩上部，锁骨肩峰端与肩胛冈之间凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the superior aspect of the shoulder, in the depression between the acromial end of the clavicle and the scapular spine
specialCategories: 手阳明与阳蹻脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 巨骨为手阳明大肠经穴，与阳蹻脉交会。善通经活络、散结消肿，主治肩关节疼痛、不能举臂及瘰疬。临床与肩髃、肩髎合用共调肩关节气血。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-16 (Jugu) is a point on the Large Intestine channel that intersects with the Yang Qiao vessel. It frees the channels, disperses binds, and reduces swelling. It treats shoulder pain with inability to raise the arm, and scrofula.

acupoints.location: 颈外侧部，胸锁乳突肌后缘，扶突穴下1寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the neck, posterior to the sternocleidomastoid, 1 cun below LI-18 (Futu)
acupoints.description: 天鼎为手阳明大肠经穴，位于颈外侧。善利咽消肿、理气散结，治咽喉肿痛、吞咽困难、瘰疬及暴喑。临床刺灸时须避开颈动脉等重要结构。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-17 (Tianding) is a point on the Large Intestine channel on the lateral neck. It benefits the throat, reduces swelling, and disperses binds. It treats sore throat, difficulty swallowing, scrofula, and sudden voice loss. Needling technique must avoid the carotid artery and other critical structures of the lateral neck.

acupoints.location: 颈外侧部，喉结旁开3寸，胸锁乳突肌前后缘之间
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the neck, level with the tip of the Adam's apple, between the sternal and clavicular heads of the sternocleidomastoid, 3 cun lateral to the laryngeal prominence
acupoints.description: 扶突为手阳明大肠经穴，位于颈外侧。善利咽消肿、理气化痰，主治咽喉肿痛、瘿气及咳喘。临床多用于甲状腺肿大、梅核气及咽喉急症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-18 (Futu) is a point on the Large Intestine channel on the lateral neck. It benefits the throat, reduces swelling, and transforms phlegm. It treats sore throat, goiter, and cough with asthma.

acupoints.location: 上唇部，鼻孔外缘直下，平水沟穴
acupoints.locationEn: On the upper lip, directly below the lateral border of the nostril, level with GV-26 (Shuigou)
acupoints.description: 口禾髎为手阳明大肠经穴，位于上唇鼻翼旁。善疏风通窍、活络止痛，治鼻塞、鼻衄、口歪及鼻息肉。为局部取穴治鼻病之代表穴，常与迎香配伍。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-19 (Kouheliao) is a point on the Large Intestine channel near the nostril. It courses wind, opens the orifices, and quickens the network vessels. It treats nasal congestion, nosebleed, deviation of the mouth, and nasal polyps.

acupoints.location: 鼻翼外缘中点旁，鼻唇沟中
acupoints.locationEn: In the nasolabial groove, at the level of the midpoint of the lateral border of the ala nasi
acupoints.description: 迎香为手阳明大肠经末穴，与足阳明胃经交会。为通鼻窍之第一要穴，善疏风清热、消肿止痛，治鼻塞、鼻渊、鼻衄及口面诸疾。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LI-20 (Yingxiang) is the terminal point of the Large Intestine channel and intersects with the Stomach channel. It is the foremost point for opening the nasal orifices. It courses wind, clears heat, and treats nasal congestion, sinusitis, nosebleed, and facial disorders.

acupoints.location: 足大趾外侧，趾甲根角旁0.1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the great toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the toenail
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.2 寸
acupoints.description: 大敦为足厥阴肝经井穴，五行属木。井穴主治「心下满」，善回阳开窍、疏肝理气。因肝经环绕阴器，故为治疗疝气的要穴，兼治崩漏、癫痫及昏厥急症。灸治疝气效果尤著。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-1 (Dadun) is the jing-well point of the Liver channel, pertaining to wood in the five phases. It is a key point for hernia (as the Liver channel encircles the genitalia), and for uterine flooding. As a well point, it restores yang and opens the portals in emergencies such as epilepsy and syncope. Moxibustion is particularly effective for hernia.

acupoints.location: 足背，第一、二趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处
acupoints.locationEn: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 1st and 2nd toes, proximal to the web margin at the junction of red and white skin
acupoints.description: 行间为足厥阴肝经荥穴，五行属火。荥穴主治「身热」，因肝属木、荥属火，木火相生，故为清泻肝经实火的第一要穴。凡肝火上炎所致头痛、目赤、口苦、失眠、易怒均为其主治范畴。泻法为主。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-2 (Xingjian) is the ying-spring point of the Liver channel, pertaining to fire in the five phases. With wood generating fire, this is the premier point for draining repletion Liver fire. It is indispensable for Liver fire flaring patterns: headache, red eyes, bitter taste, insomnia, and irritability. Reducing technique is standard.

acupoints.location: 足背，第一、二跖骨间，跖骨结合部之前凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the dorsum of the foot, in the depression distal to the junction of the 1st and 2nd metatarsals
acupoints.description: 太冲为足厥阴肝经原穴兼输穴，是疏肝理气、平肝息风的代表穴位。临床凡肝气郁结、肝阳上亢、肝风内动等肝系病证多取此穴。与合谷相配称“四关穴”，共奏疏调气机之功，为针灸临床最经典的穴位配伍之一。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-3 (Taichong) is both the yuan-source point and shu-stream point of the Liver channel, making it the principal point for coursing the Liver, rectifying qi, and leveling Liver yang. It is essential in treating Liver qi stagnation, Liver yang rising, and Liver wind stirring internally. Paired with LI-4 as the "four gates," it is one of the most celebrated point combinations in acupuncture for regulating the qi dynamic of the entire body.

acupoints.location: 足内踝前，胫骨前肌腱内侧凹陷中，内踝尖前约1寸
acupoints.locationEn: Anterior to the medial malleolus, in the depression medial to the tendon of tibialis anterior, approximately 1 cun anterior to the tip of the medial malleolus
acupoints.description: 中封为足厥阴肝经经穴，五行属金。经穴主治「喘咳寒热」，善疏肝理气、清利下焦湿热。为治疗疝气、遗精及小便不利的常用穴，兼治内踝部疼痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-4 (Zhongfeng) is the jing-river point of the Liver channel, pertaining to metal in the five phases. It courses the Liver and clears the lower burner, treating hernia, seminal emission, and urinary difficulty. It is also a useful local point for medial ankle pain.

acupoints.location: 小腿内侧，内踝尖上5寸，胫骨内侧面中央
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the lower leg, 5 cun above the tip of the medial malleolus, on the center of the medial surface of the tibia
acupoints.description: 蠡沟为足厥阴肝经络穴。络穴联络表里经，故既治肝经本经病变，亦可治胆经病。因肝经循行绕阴器，故善治下焦及生殖系统疾患，为调经止带、治疗阴痒阴挺的常用穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-5 (Ligou) is the luo-connecting point of the Liver channel. As a luo point, it treats both Liver and Gallbladder channel pathology. Because the Liver channel encircles the genitalia, it is particularly effective for genitourinary and gynecological disorders including leukorrhea, genital itching, and menstrual irregularity.

acupoints.location: 小腿内侧，内踝尖上7寸，胫骨内侧面中央
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the lower leg, 7 cun above the tip of the medial malleolus, on the center of the medial surface of the tibia
acupoints.description: 中都为足厥阴肝经郄穴。郄穴善治本经急性病证及出血证，故中都尤善止血，为治疗崩漏、月经过多及产后恶露不绝的要穴。兼治疝气及少腹疼痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-6 (Zhongdu) is the xi-cleft point of the Liver channel. Xi-cleft points excel at treating acute and painful conditions as well as blood disorders of their respective channels. Zhongdu is therefore a critical point for uterine bleeding emergencies, menorrhagia, and persistent lochia, alongside hernia and lower abdominal pain.

acupoints.location: 膝内侧，屈膝时，当膝关节内侧端，股骨内上髁后缘，半腱肌、半膜肌止端前缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the knee, with the knee flexed, in the depression above the medial end of the popliteal crease, posterior to the medial epicondyle of the femur, anterior to the insertion of semimembranosus and semitendinosus
acupoints.description: 曲泉为足厥阴肝经合穴，五行属水，水能涵木。合穴主治「逆气而泄」，善清利下焦湿热，治疗泌尿生殖系统疾患。兼能滋养肝肾之阴，用于肝肾阴虚证。为膝内侧痛的局部要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-8 (Ququan) is the he-sea point of the Liver channel, pertaining to water in the five phases (water nourishes wood). It excels at clearing damp-heat from the lower burner for genitourinary disorders, and enriches Liver-Kidney yin. It is used for urinary difficulty, menstrual disorders, impotence, and is a local point for medial knee pain.

acupoints.location: 侧腹部，第十一肋骨游离端下际
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the abdomen, at the lower border of the free end of the 11th rib
acupoints.description: 章门为脾之募穴，八会穴之脏会，足厥阴与足少阳交会穴。作为脏会，统治五脏疾患；作为脾之募穴，善治脾胃运化失常。临床以疏肝健脾、理气消积见长，为肝脾不调、腹胀泄泻及痞块的要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-13 (Zhangmen) is the front-mu collecting point of the Spleen and the hui-meeting point of the zang-organs (one of the eight influential points). It commands all five zang-organ disorders. Clinically it courses the Liver and fortifies the Spleen, treating Liver-Spleen disharmony, abdominal distension, diarrhea, and abdominal masses. Its dual role as Spleen mu and zang hui makes it uniquely important.

acupoints.location: 乳头直下，第六肋间隙，前正中线旁开4寸
acupoints.locationEn: Directly below the nipple, in the 6th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline
specialCategories: 足太阴厥阴阴维脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 期门为肝之募穴，足太阴、足厥阴与阴维脉交会穴。作为肝之募穴，为诊治肝胆疾患的首选穴。善疏肝理气、活血化瘀，主治胸胁胀痛、肝炎及呕吐呃逆。张仲景《伤寒论》中常用期门治疗肝气犯胃之证。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LR-14 (Qimen) is the front-mu collecting point of the Liver and a meeting point of the Foot Taiyin, Foot Jueyin, and Yinwei vessel. As the Liver mu point, it is the foremost point for diagnosing and treating Liver and Gallbladder disorders. It courses Liver qi, quickens blood stasis, and is used for chest and hypochondriac pain, hepatitis, and vomiting. Zhang Zhongjing frequently prescribed it in the Shang Han Lun for Liver qi invading the Stomach.

acupoints.location: 胸前壁外上方，前正中线旁开6寸，平第一肋间隙处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral aspect of the anterior thorax, level with the 1st intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline
acupoints.description: 中府为手太阴肺经募穴，亦为手太阴与足太阴之交会穴。临床以宣肺止咳、降逆平喘见长，为治疗肺系疾患之要穴。因居肺募，可直泻肺之实邪，治咳喘胸闷尤效。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-1 (Zhongfu) is the front-mu collecting point of the Lung and the intersection point of the Hand and Foot Taiyin channels. It is a primary point for diffusing the lung, stopping cough, and calming wheezing. As the front-mu point, it is especially effective for repletion patterns of the lung with cough, dyspnea, and chest oppression.

acupoints.location: 胸前壁外上方，锁骨下窝凹陷中，前正中线旁开6寸
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression below the clavicle, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline
acupoints.description: 云门为手太阴肺经穴，居锁骨下窝，为肺气出入之门户。善宣肺降气、清热除烦，常与中府配伍治疗咳喘胸满诸症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-2 (Yunmen) lies in the infraclavicular fossa and is regarded as the gateway of lung qi. It excels at diffusing the lung, descending qi, and clearing heat. It is often combined with LU-1 for cough, dyspnea, and chest fullness.

acupoints.location: 臂内侧面，腋前纹头下3寸，肱二头肌桡侧缘
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial aspect of the upper arm, 3 cun below the axillary fold, on the radial side of the biceps brachii
acupoints.description: 天府为手太阴肺经穴，位于上臂内侧。善宣肺清热、凉血止血，可治鼻衄、吐血等血热妄行诸症，并调气安神。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-3 (Tianfu) is located on the medial aspect of the upper arm. It excels at diffusing the lung, clearing heat, and cooling the blood to stop bleeding. It is indicated for nosebleed, hemoptysis, and other bleeding due to blood heat, as well as for calming the spirit.

acupoints.location: 臂内侧面，腋前纹头下4寸，肱二头肌桡侧缘
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial aspect of the upper arm, 4 cun below the axillary fold, on the radial side of the biceps brachii
acupoints.description: 侠白为手太阴肺经穴，位于天府下1寸。善宣肺理气、宽胸和中，常用于咳嗽气短、胸闷心悸及上臂内侧疼痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-4 (Xiabai) is located 1 cun below LU-3 on the medial upper arm. It diffuses the lung, regulates qi, and broadens the chest. It is commonly used for cough, shortness of breath, chest oppression, and medial upper arm pain.

acupoints.location: 肘横纹中，肱二头肌腱桡侧凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the cubital crease, in the depression radial to the biceps brachii tendon
acupoints.description: 尺泽为手太阴肺经合穴，五行属水。善清泻肺热、降逆止咳，为治疗肺热咳嗽、咯血、咽痛之要穴。因合穴治腑，亦可疏利肘臂经络。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-5 (Chize) is the he-sea point of the Lung channel with the five-phase attribute of water. It excels at clearing lung heat, descending counterflow, and stopping cough. It is a key point for lung-heat cough, hemoptysis, and sore throat, and also treats elbow and arm disorders along the channel.

acupoints.location: 前臂掌面桡侧，尺泽与太渊连线上，腕横纹上7寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the palmar aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting LU-5 and LU-9, 7 cun above the wrist crease
acupoints.description: 孔最为手太阴肺经之郄穴，善清热止血、宣肺平喘。郄穴主急症，本穴尤擅治肺系急性出血如咯血、鼻衄，并治咳喘、咽痛、失音等症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-6 (Kongzui) is the xi-cleft point of the Lung channel. Xi-cleft points treat acute conditions, and this point excels at clearing heat and stopping bleeding. It is especially effective for acute lung-related bleeding such as hemoptysis and nosebleed, as well as cough, asthma, sore throat, and loss of voice.

acupoints.location: 桡骨茎突上方，腕横纹上1.5寸
acupoints.locationEn: Above the styloid process of the radius, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease
acupoints.description: 列缺为手太阴肺经络穴，八脉交会穴之一（通于任脉），亦属四总穴。其“头项寻列缺”之歌诀广为传诵，表明该穴善治头项部疾患。临床以宣肺解表、通调任脉为主要功效，常用于外感风邪引起的头痛、咳嗽及咽喉诸症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-7 (Lieque) is the luo-connecting point of the Lung channel and one of the eight confluent points of the extraordinary vessels (connecting to the Conception Vessel). It belongs to the four command points ("for the head and nape, seek Lieque"). Clinically it excels at diffusing Lung qi, releasing the exterior, and treating disorders of the head, neck, and throat. Its dual role as a Lung luo point and extraordinary vessel confluent makes it uniquely effective for both respiratory and Ren Mai pathology.

acupoints.location: 前臂掌面桡侧，桡骨茎突内侧，腕横纹上1寸，桡动脉搏动处
acupoints.locationEn: On the palmar aspect of the forearm, 1 cun above the wrist crease, in the depression on the medial side of the radial styloid process, where the radial artery pulsates
acupoints.description: 经渠为手太阴肺经经穴，五行属金。位于桡动脉搏动处，禁灸。善宣肺利咽、降逆平喘，治咳喘、胸痛及咽喉肿痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-8 (Jingqu) is the jing-river point of the Lung channel with the five-phase attribute of metal. Located over the radial artery pulse, moxibustion is contraindicated. It diffuses the lung, benefits the throat, and descends counterflow to treat cough, asthma, chest pain, and sore throat.

acupoints.location: 腕横纹桡侧端，桡动脉搏动处
acupoints.locationEn: At the radial end of the wrist crease, in the depression where the radial artery pulsates
acupoints.description: 太渊为手太阴肺经输穴、原穴，八会穴之脉会，五行属土。为肺经补虚要穴，善补肺益气、止咳化痰，兼通调血脉。因系脉会，凡血脉病变皆可取之。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-9 (Taiyuan) is the shu-stream point, yuan-source point, and the influential point of the vessels among the eight influential points. With its earth-phase attribute, it is the key tonification point of the Lung channel. It supplements lung qi, stops cough, transforms phlegm, and regulates the blood vessels. As the influential point of the vessels, it treats all vascular disorders.

acupoints.location: 手掌，第一掌骨中点桡侧，赤白肉际处
acupoints.locationEn: On the thenar eminence, at the midpoint of the 1st metacarpal bone on the radial side, at the junction of the red and white skin
acupoints.description: 鱼际为手太阴肺经荥穴，五行属火。善清肺泻热、利咽止痛，为治疗咽喉肿痛、失音之要穴。荥穴主身热，故善清肺经郁热。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-10 (Yuji) is the ying-spring point of the Lung channel with the five-phase attribute of fire. It excels at clearing lung heat, benefiting the throat, and stopping pain. It is a key point for sore swollen throat and loss of voice. As a ying-spring point, it is effective for clearing depressive heat from the lung channel.

acupoints.location: 手拇指末节桡侧，距指甲角0.1寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the radial side of the thumb, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.1 寸
acupoints.description: 少商为手太阴肺经井穴，五行属木。善清热利咽、开窍醒神，为急救要穴之一。点刺出血治咽喉肿痛、高热昏迷疗效显著。
acupoints.descriptionEn: LU-11 (Shaoshang) is the jing-well point of the Lung channel with the five-phase attribute of wood. It excels at clearing heat, benefiting the throat, and opening the orifices to arouse the spirit. It is one of the key emergency points. Pricking to bleed is remarkably effective for sore swollen throat and high fever with loss of consciousness.

acupoints.location: 胸部，第四肋间隙，乳头外1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the chest, in the 4th intercostal space, 1 cun lateral to the nipple
acupoints.description: 天池为手厥阴心包经首穴，位于第四肋间隙。善宽胸理气，治胸闷、心烦。兼活血消痈，治乳痈、腋下肿。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-1 (Tianchi) is the first point of the Pericardium channel, located in the 4th intercostal space. It broadens the chest and regulates qi for chest oppression, and quickens the blood for breast abscess and axillary swelling.

acupoints.location: 臂前区，腋前纹头下2寸，肱二头肌两头之间
acupoints.locationEn: On the anterior aspect of the arm, 2 cun below the anterior axillary fold, between the two heads of biceps brachii
acupoints.description: 天泉位于臂前区，肱二头肌两头之间。善宽胸理气，治心痛、胸闷。兼通络止痛，治臂痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-2 (Tianquan) is located on the anterior arm between the two heads of biceps brachii. It broadens the chest and regulates qi for heart pain and chest oppression, and frees the connecting vessels for arm pain.

acupoints.location: 肘横纹中，肱二头肌肌腱尺侧缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the transverse cubital crease, at the ulnar side of the tendon of biceps brachii
acupoints.depth: 直刺，或点刺出血 0.5–1 寸
acupoints.description: 曲泽为手厥阴心包经合穴，五行属水。善清心泻热、和胃降逆，治心痛、心悸、呕吐。点刺出血治中暑、急性胃肠炎。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-3 (Quze) is the he-sea point of the Pericardium channel, attributed to Water. It clears the heart, drains heat, and harmonizes the stomach. Pricking to bleed is effective for heatstroke and acute gastroenteritis.

acupoints.location: 前臂掌侧，曲泽与大陵连线上，腕横纹上5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the palmar aspect of the forearm, on the line between PC-3 (Quze) and PC-7 (Daling), 5 cun above the wrist crease
acupoints.description: 郄门为手厥阴心包经郄穴。善宁心安神、宽胸理气，治急性心痛、心悸。兼活血止血，治呕血、衄血。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-4 (Ximen) is the xi-cleft point of the Pericardium channel. It calms the spirit and broadens the chest for acute heart pain and palpitations, and also quickens the blood and stops bleeding.

acupoints.location: 前臂掌侧，曲泽与大陵连线上，腕横纹上3寸，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间
acupoints.locationEn: On the palmar aspect of the forearm, 3 cun above the wrist crease, between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis
acupoints.description: 间使为手厥阴心包经经穴，五行属金。善宁心安神，治癫狂痫、心悸。兼和胃降逆，治呕吐。古为治疟要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-5 (Jianshi) is the jing-river point of the Pericardium channel, attributed to Metal. It calms the spirit for mania and epilepsy, harmonizes the stomach for vomiting, and was classically a principal point for treating malaria.

acupoints.location: 腕横纹上2寸，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间
acupoints.locationEn: 2 cun above the wrist crease between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis
acupoints.description: 内关为手厥阴心包经络穴，八脉交会穴之一（通于阴维脉）。该穴宁心安神、理气和胃、宽胸止痛，是治疗心胸胃疾患的核心穴位。临床广泛应用于心悸、胸痛、胃痛、呕吐、眩晕、失眠等症，尤以止呕效果显著，现代研究亦证实其抗心律失常的作用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-6 (Neiguan) is the luo-connecting point of the Pericardium channel and one of the eight confluent points of the extraordinary vessels (connecting to the Yin Linking Vessel). It is the foremost point for quieting the Heart, calming the spirit, harmonizing the Stomach, and relaxing the chest. Its antiemetic action is particularly notable and well-supported by modern research. Clinically indispensable for palpitations, chest pain, nausea, vomiting, and insomnia.

acupoints.location: 腕掌横纹中点，掌长肌腱与桡侧腕屈肌腱之间
acupoints.locationEn: At the midpoint of the wrist crease, between the tendons of palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis
acupoints.description: 大陵为手厥阴心包经输穴兼原穴，五行属土。善清心安神，治心痛、心悸、失眠、癫狂痫。兼和胃宽胸，治胃痛、口臭。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-7 (Daling) is both the shu-stream and yuan-source point of the Pericardium channel, attributed to Earth. It clears the heart and calms the spirit for heart pain, insomnia, and mental disorders, and harmonizes the stomach for gastric pain and halitosis.

acupoints.location: 手掌心，第二、三掌骨之间偏于第三掌骨，握拳时中指尖所指处
acupoints.locationEn: In the center of the palm, between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpal bones, proximal to the 3rd metacarpophalangeal joint, where the tip of the middle finger rests when a fist is made
acupoints.description: 劳宫为手厥阴心包经荥穴，五行属火。善清心泻热、醒神开窍，为治中风昏迷、中暑的急救穴之一。兼治口疮、口臭、癫狂。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-8 (Laogong) is the ying-spring point of the Pericardium channel, attributed to Fire. It clears heart heat and revives consciousness, serving as an important emergency point for wind-stroke coma and heatstroke. It also treats oral ulcers, halitosis, and mania.

acupoints.location: 手中指末端指尖中央
acupoints.locationEn: At the center of the tip of the middle finger
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.1 寸
acupoints.description: 中冲为手厥阴心包经井穴，五行属木。善醒神开窍、清热泻火，为中风昏迷、中暑、昏厥的急救要穴。常以三棱针点刺出血。
acupoints.descriptionEn: PC-9 (Zhongchong) is the jing-well point of the Pericardium channel, attributed to Wood. It is a critical emergency point for reviving consciousness in wind-stroke coma, heatstroke, and syncope. Typically pricked with a three-edged needle to bleed.

acupoints.location: 小指尺侧指甲角旁约0.1寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the ulnar side of the little finger, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail
acupoints.description: 少泽为手太阳小肠经井穴，五行属金。主治乳少、乳痈，为催乳要穴。兼清上焦之热，治头目、咽喉诸疾。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-1 (Shaoze) is the jing-well point of the Small Intestine channel, attributed to Metal in the five phases. It is the principal point for promoting lactation and treating breast disorders. It also clears heat from the upper jiao and treats conditions of the head, eyes, and throat.

acupoints.location: 第五掌指关节尺侧远端赤白肉际凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression distal to the ulnar side of the 5th metacarpophalangeal joint, at the junction of the red and white skin
acupoints.description: 前谷为手太阳小肠经荥穴，五行属水。善清头面、咽喉之热，兼治乳少。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-2 (Qiangu) is the ying-spring point of the Small Intestine channel, attributed to Water. It clears heat from the head, face, and throat and also treats insufficient lactation.

acupoints.location: 第五掌指关节尺侧近端赤白肉际凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression proximal to the ulnar side of the 5th metacarpophalangeal joint, at the junction of the red and white skin
acupoints.description: 后溪为手太阳小肠经输穴，八脉交会穴之一，通于督脉，又为马丹阳天星十二穴之一。善治头项强痛、落枕、腰背痛等督脉病证，兼清心安神，治癫狂痫。临床常与申脉（BL-62）配合运用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-3 (Houxi) is the shu-stream point of the Small Intestine channel and one of the Eight Confluent points, connecting to the Du Mai (Governing Vessel). It is also among Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. Classically paired with BL-62 (Shenmai), it is the chief point for disorders of the spine, neck stiffness, and Du Mai pathology. It also clears the heart and calms the spirit in mania and epilepsy.

acupoints.location: 手掌尺侧，第五掌骨基底与钩骨之间凹陷中，赤白肉际处
acupoints.locationEn: On the ulnar side of the palm, in the depression between the base of the 5th metacarpal bone and the hamate bone, at the junction of the red and white skin
acupoints.description: 腕骨为手太阳小肠经原穴。善清湿热、退黄疸，为治黄疸之经验穴。兼治腕部及上肢疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-4 (Wangu) is the yuan-source point of the Small Intestine channel. It is especially effective for clearing damp-heat and treating jaundice, and is also used for wrist and upper limb disorders.

acupoints.location: 腕背横纹尺侧端，尺骨茎突与三角骨之间凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: At the ulnar end of the dorsal wrist crease, in the depression between the ulnar styloid process and the triquetral bone
acupoints.description: 阳谷为手太阳小肠经经穴，五行属火。清头面之热，安神定志，兼治腕部疾患。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-5 (Yanggu) is the jing-river point of the Small Intestine channel, attributed to Fire. It clears heat from the head and face, calms the spirit, and treats wrist disorders.

acupoints.location: 前臂背面尺侧，尺骨茎突桡侧骨缝凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the dorsal aspect of the forearm, in the bony cleft on the radial side of the ulnar styloid process
acupoints.description: 养老为手太阳小肠经郄穴。善治目疾，尤宜老年视力减退。兼舒筋活络，治肩背腰部急性疼痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-6 (Yanglao) is the xi-cleft point of the Small Intestine channel. Its name means 'Nourishing the Aged,' reflecting its traditional use for vision disorders in the elderly. It also relaxes the sinews and is effective for acute pain of the shoulder, back, and lumbar region.

acupoints.location: 前臂背面尺侧，阳谷与小海连线上，腕背横纹上5寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the ulnar aspect of the forearm, on the line connecting SI-5 (Yanggu) and SI-8 (Xiaohai), 5 cun above the dorsal wrist crease
acupoints.description: 支正为手太阳小肠经络穴，联络手少阴心经。善安神定志，治癫狂、心神不宁。经验上为治疣要穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-7 (Zhizheng) is the luo-connecting point of the Small Intestine channel, linking to the Heart channel. It calms the spirit and is used for psychiatric disorders. It is also an important empirical point for treating warts.

acupoints.location: 肘内侧，尺骨鹰嘴与肱骨内上髁之间凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: Between the olecranon of the ulna and the medial epicondyle of the humerus, in the depression of the ulnar groove
acupoints.description: 小海为手太阳小肠经合穴，五行属土。主治肘臂疼痛麻木，兼安神定志。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-8 (Xiaohai) is the he-sea point of the Small Intestine channel, attributed to Earth. It primarily treats elbow and arm pain and numbness, and also calms the spirit.

acupoints.location: 肩关节后下方，臂内收时腋后纹头上1寸
acupoints.locationEn: Posterior and inferior to the shoulder joint, 1 cun above the posterior axillary fold when the arm is adducted
acupoints.description: 肩贞位于肩关节后下方，为治疗肩部疾患的常用穴，尤善治肩周炎。兼散结消肿，治瘰疬。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-9 (Jianzhen) is located posterior and inferior to the shoulder joint. It is commonly used for shoulder disorders, especially frozen shoulder, and also disperses nodulation.

acupoints.location: 肩胛骨冈下窝中央凹陷中，约肩胛冈下缘与肩胛骨下角连线上1/3处
acupoints.locationEn: In the center of the infrascapular fossa, at the junction of the upper and middle third of the line from the midpoint of the spine of the scapula to the inferior angle of the scapula
acupoints.description: 天宗位于肩胛冈下窝中央，为治疗肩胛区疼痛及肩周炎之要穴。兼通乳消痈。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-11 (Tianzong) is located in the center of the infrascapular fossa. It is a key point for scapular pain and frozen shoulder, and also benefits breast disorders.

acupoints.location: 下颌角后方，胸锁乳突肌前缘凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: Posterior to the angle of the mandible, in the depression on the anterior border of the sternocleidomastoid muscle
acupoints.description: 天容位于下颌角后方，为治疗咽喉肿痛、扁桃体炎的常用穴，兼治耳疾及颈部肿痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-17 (Tianrong) is located behind the angle of the mandible. It is commonly used for sore throat, tonsillitis, and ear disorders, as well as neck swelling and pain.

acupoints.location: 面部，耳屏前，下颌骨髁状突后方，张口时呈凹陷处
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, anterior to the tragus, posterior to the condyloid process of the mandible, in the depression formed when the mouth is open
acupoints.description: 听宫为手太阳小肠经末穴，位于耳屏前方。为治疗各种耳疾的首选穴之一，善聪耳开窍。常与听会（GB-2）、耳门（SJ-21）配伍使用。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SI-19 (Tinggong) is the final point of the Small Intestine channel, located anterior to the tragus. It is one of the principal points for all ear disorders. It is frequently combined with GB-2 (Tinghui) and SJ-21 (Ermen) for comprehensive ear treatment.

acupoints.location: 足大趾内侧，趾甲角旁开0.1寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the great toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.1 寸
acupoints.description: 隐白为足太阴脾经井穴，五行属木。善健脾统血、回阳救逆，为治各种出血症之要穴。灸隐白止血崩，疗效卓著。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-1 (Yinbai) is the jing-well point of the Spleen channel with the five-phase attribute of wood. It fortifies the spleen and governs the blood. It is a key point for various bleeding disorders. Moxibustion at SP-1 to stop uterine bleeding (beng lou) is remarkably effective.

acupoints.location: 足大趾内侧，第一跖趾关节前下方赤白肉际处
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial side of the great toe, in the depression distal and inferior to the 1st metatarsophalangeal joint, at the junction of the red and white skin
acupoints.description: 大都为足太阴脾经荥穴，五行属火。善健脾和中、清热利湿，治腹胀、胃痛及热病。临床常与太白、三阴交同用以健运脾阳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-2 (Dadu) is the ying-spring point of the Spleen channel with the five-phase attribute of fire. It fortifies the spleen, harmonizes the center, and clears heat-dampness. It treats abdominal distension, stomach pain, and febrile disease.

acupoints.location: 足内侧缘，第一跖趾关节后下方赤白肉际凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial border of the foot, in the depression proximal and inferior to the 1st metatarsophalangeal joint, at the junction of the red and white skin
acupoints.description: 太白为足太阴脾经输穴兼原穴，五行属土。为脾经补虚之要穴，善健脾化湿、和胃止痛，治脾虚诸症。临床配足三里、三阴交以培补后天之本。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-3 (Taibai) is the shu-stream and yuan-source point of the Spleen channel with the five-phase attribute of earth. It is the key tonification point of the Spleen channel. It fortifies the spleen, transforms dampness, and harmonizes the stomach, treating all spleen vacuity patterns.

acupoints.location: 足内侧缘，第一跖骨基底部前下方
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial aspect of the foot, in the depression distal and inferior to the base of the 1st metatarsal
acupoints.description: 公孙为足太阴脾经络穴，八脉交会穴之一（通于冲脉）。该穴健脾和胃、理气调经，是治疗脾胃疾患和冲脉病变的要穴。临床用于胃痛、呕吐、腹痛、腹胀、泄泻、痢疾等消化系统疾患，以及心烦失眠、狂证等神志疾病，体现络穴沟通表里、交会穴联通奇经的特点。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-4 (Gongsun) is the luo-connecting point of the Spleen channel and one of the eight confluent points of the extraordinary vessels (connecting to the Chong Mai / Thoroughfare Vessel). It fortifies the Spleen, harmonizes the Stomach, and rectifies qi. Its dual status as a luo point and extraordinary-vessel confluent gives it broad clinical reach for gastrointestinal disorders (stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhea, dysentery) and for Chong Mai pathology such as menstrual irregularities and abdominal urgency.

acupoints.location: 足内踝前下方凹陷中，内踝尖前下方，舟骨结节与内踝尖连线的中点
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression anteroinferior to the medial malleolus, midway between the navicular tuberosity and the tip of the medial malleolus
acupoints.description: 商丘为足太阴脾经经穴，五行属金。善健脾化湿、通调肠胃，治腹胀、泄泻、黄疸及踝关节疾患。临床常与丘墟、解溪相配治踝关节扭伤。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-5 (Shangqiu) is the jing-river point of the Spleen channel with the five-phase attribute of metal. It fortifies the spleen, transforms dampness, and regulates the intestines. It treats abdominal distension, diarrhea, jaundice, and ankle disorders.

acupoints.location: 内踝尖直上3寸，胫骨内侧面后缘
acupoints.locationEn: 3 cun above the tip of the medial malleolus, on the posterior border of the medial aspect of the tibia
indications: 脾胃虚弱，肠鸣腹胀，泄泻
acupoints.description: 三阴交为足太阴脾经穴，是足三阴经（脾、肝、肾）的交会穴，故能同调脾、肝、肾三脏。该穴功善健脾益血、调肝补肾、安神助眠，为妇科要穴，广泛用于月经不调、崩漏、带下及不孕等症。孕妇禁针。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-6 (Sanyinjiao) is the crossing point of the three foot yin channels (Spleen, Liver, and Kidney), giving it the unique ability to influence all three yin organs simultaneously. It fortifies the Spleen and boosts blood, regulates the Liver, and supplements the Kidney. It is the single most important point in gynecology, widely used for menstrual irregularities, uterine bleeding, vaginal discharge, and infertility. Contraindicated for needling during pregnancy.

acupoints.location: 小腿内侧，阴陵泉下3寸，胫骨内侧缘后方
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial aspect of the lower leg, 3 cun below SP-9 (Yinlingquan), on the line connecting SP-9 and the medial malleolus, posterior to the medial border of the tibia
acupoints.description: 地机为足太阴脾经郄穴，善健脾渗湿、调经止痛。郄穴主急症，本穴尤擅治痛经、急性腹痛及崩漏等妇科急症。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-8 (Diji) is the xi-cleft point of the Spleen channel. It fortifies the spleen, percolates dampness, and regulates menstruation. As a xi-cleft point treating acute conditions, it is especially effective for dysmenorrhea, acute abdominal pain, and uterine bleeding.

acupoints.location: 胫骨内侧髁后下方凹陷处
acupoints.locationEn: In the depression posterior and inferior to the medial condyle of the tibia
acupoints.description: 阴陵泉为足太阴脾经合穴，位于胫骨内侧髁后下方凹陷处。该穴健脾利湿、通利三焦，为治疗湿邪为患的首选穴位。凡水肿、黄疸、腹胀、泄泻等脾虚湿盛之症，均可取用。亦用于膝关节局部疼痛，为脾经合穴的经典代表。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-9 (Yinlingquan) is the he-sea point of the Spleen channel, located in the depression posterior and inferior to the medial tibial condyle. It is the foremost point for fortifying the Spleen and disinhibiting dampness, as well as for freeing the Triple Burner water passages. It is the first-choice point in all dampness-predominant conditions including edema, jaundice, abdominal distension, and diarrhea. It is also used locally for knee pain.

acupoints.location: 大腿内侧，髌底内侧端上2寸，股四头肌内侧头隆起处
acupoints.locationEn: On the medial aspect of the thigh, 2 cun above the mediosuperior border of the patella, in the prominence of the vastus medialis
acupoints.description: 血海为足太阴脾经穴，为治血证之要穴。善活血化瘀、调经统血、祛风止痒，凡血分病变如月经不调、皮肤瘙痒皆可取之。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-10 (Xuehai, "Sea of Blood") is a key point of the Spleen channel for treating blood disorders. It quickens the blood, transforms stasis, regulates menstruation, and stops itching. It treats all blood-level conditions including menstrual disorders, skin diseases, and itching.

acupoints.location: 腹部，脐中旁开4寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the abdomen, 4 cun lateral to the center of the umbilicus
specialCategories: 足太阴与阴维脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 大横为足太阴脾经穴，与阴维脉交会。善温中散寒、调理肠胃，治腹痛、泄泻、便秘及虫积腹痛。临床为肠腑病变之常用腹部取穴，虚寒证尤宜艾灸。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-15 (Daheng) is a point on the Spleen channel intersecting with the Yin Wei vessel. It warms the center, disperses cold, and regulates the intestines. It treats abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, and parasitic abdominal pain.

acupoints.location: 侧胸部，腋中线上，第六肋间隙处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral chest, on the mid-axillary line, in the 6th intercostal space
acupoints.description: 大包为脾之大络，统络阴阳诸经。善统血、宽胸利胁，治全身疼痛、四肢无力及胸胁痛。为脾统血之体穴代表。
acupoints.descriptionEn: SP-21 (Dabao) is the great luo-connecting point of the Spleen, which connects all yin and yang channels. It governs the blood and broadens the chest. It treats generalized body pain, weakness of the limbs, and chest-costal pain. It embodies the spleen's function of governing the blood.

acupoints.location: 面部，瞳孔直下，眼球与眶下缘之间
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, directly below the pupil, between the eyeball and the infraorbital ridge
acupoints.depth: 紧靠眶下缘缓慢直刺 0.3–0.7 寸
specialCategories: 足阳明与阳蹻脉、任脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 承泣为足阳明胃经起始穴，与阳蹻脉、任脉交会。善明目退翳、祛风散邪，为眼科要穴。临床治疗目赤肿痛、夜盲、近视及面肌瞤动，针刺须轻柔缓进。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-1 (Chengqi) is the starting point of the Stomach channel, intersecting with the Yang Qiao vessel and Ren vessel. It brightens the eyes and retreats visual obstruction, and is a key point in ophthalmology.

acupoints.location: 面部，瞳孔直下，眶下孔凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, directly below the pupil, in the depression of the infraorbital foramen
acupoints.description: 四白为足阳明胃经穴，位于眶下孔处。善明目止痛、祛风通络，为治面瘫、三叉神经痛之常用穴。临床以平刺或斜刺为宜，常配阳白、颊车疏通面部经气。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-2 (Sibai) is a point on the Stomach channel at the infraorbital foramen. It brightens the eyes, stops pain, and frees the network vessels. It is commonly used for facial paralysis and trigeminal neuralgia.

acupoints.location: 面部，口角旁开0.4寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, 0.4 cun lateral to the corner of the mouth
specialCategories: 手足阳明与阳蹻脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 地仓为足阳明胃经穴，与手阳明、阳蹻脉交会。善祛风通络、舒筋活络，为治面瘫口歪之要穴。常与颊车透刺治口角㖞斜，乃治面瘫之经典配伍。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-4 (Dicang) is a point on the Stomach channel intersecting with the Large Intestine channel and Yang Qiao vessel. It dispels wind and frees the network vessels. It is a key point for facial paralysis and deviation of the mouth.

acupoints.location: 面部，下颌角前上方约一横指，咬肌中，咬紧牙时咬肌隆起处
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, one finger-breadth anterior and superior to the angle of the mandible, in the prominence of the masseter muscle when clenching the teeth
acupoints.depth: 直刺或向地仓方向平刺 0.3–0.5 寸
acupoints.description: 颊车为足阳明胃经穴，位于咬肌隆起处。善祛风通络、利牙关，为治面瘫口歪、牙痛及颞颌关节紊乱之要穴。临床多透刺地仓，调畅局部气血以舒筋正口。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-6 (Jiache) is a point on the Stomach channel in the masseter muscle. It dispels wind, frees the network vessels, and benefits the jaw. It is a key point for facial paralysis, toothache, and temporomandibular joint disorders.

acupoints.location: 面部，颧弓下缘凹陷中，下颌骨髁突前方
acupoints.locationEn: On the face, in the depression between the zygomatic arch and the mandibular notch, anterior to the condyloid process of the mandible
specialCategories: 足阳明与足少阳交会穴
acupoints.description: 下关为足阳明胃经穴，与足少阳胆经交会。善通络止痛、利牙关、聪耳，为治牙痛、颞颌关节病及耳疾之要穴。临床针刺须避开血管神经，宜直刺或略向下刺入。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-7 (Xiaguan) is a point on the Stomach channel intersecting with the Gallbladder channel. It frees the network vessels, stops pain, and sharpens hearing. It is a key point for toothache, TMJ disorders, and ear disease.

acupoints.location: 头侧部，额角发际上0.5寸，头正中线旁开4.5寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the head, 0.5 cun above the anterior hairline at the corner of the forehead, 4.5 cun lateral to the midline
specialCategories: 足阳明与足少阳、阳维脉交会穴
acupoints.description: 头维为足阳明胃经穴，与足少阳、阳维脉交会。善疏风清热、明目止痛，为治头痛、眩晕及目疾之常用穴。临床多与率谷、风池相配以清阳明、少阳之热。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-8 (Touwei) is a point on the Stomach channel intersecting with the Gallbladder channel and Yang Wei vessel. It courses wind, clears heat, and brightens the eyes. It is commonly used for headache, dizziness, and eye disorders.

acupoints.location: 上腹部，脐中上4寸，前正中线旁开2寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the upper abdomen, 4 cun above the umbilicus, 2 cun lateral to the anterior midline
acupoints.description: 梁门为足阳明胃经穴，位于上腹部。善和胃理气、消食导滞，主治胃痛、呕吐、食欲不振及腹胀。临床常与中脘、足三里同用以和胃理气。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-21 (Liangmen) is a point on the Stomach channel on the upper abdomen. It harmonizes the stomach, regulates qi, and disperses food stagnation. It treats stomach pain, vomiting, poor appetite, and abdominal distension.

acupoints.location: 腹部，脐中旁开2寸
acupoints.locationEn: On the abdomen, 2 cun lateral to the center of the umbilicus
acupoints.description: 天枢为大肠之募穴，位于脐旁。善调中和胃、理气消滞，为治疗肠胃疾患之要穴，尤擅治泄泻、便秘、腹痛。为腹部常用要穴，可灸可针，功擅调畅大肠气机。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-25 (Tianshu) is the front-mu collecting point of the Large Intestine. It regulates the center, harmonizes the stomach, and disperses stagnation. It is a key point for gastrointestinal disorders, especially diarrhea, constipation, and abdominal pain.

acupoints.location: 大腿前面，髌底外侧端上2寸，股外侧肌与股直肌腱之间
acupoints.locationEn: On the anterior thigh, 2 cun above the laterosuperior border of the patella, between the vastus lateralis and the rectus femoris tendon
acupoints.description: 梁丘为足阳明胃经郄穴，善和胃止痛，为治急性胃痛之首选穴。郄穴主急症，尤擅治胃脘急性疼痛及膝部肿痛。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-34 (Liangqiu) is the xi-cleft point of the Stomach channel. It harmonizes the stomach and stops pain. It is the first-choice point for acute stomach pain. As a xi-cleft point treating acute conditions, it is especially effective for acute epigastric pain and knee swelling.

acupoints.location: 膝部，髌韧带外侧凹陷中
acupoints.locationEn: On the knee, in the depression lateral to the patellar ligament
acupoints.description: 犊鼻为足阳明胃经穴，位于膝眼外侧。善活血通络、散风祛湿，为治膝关节病之要穴，常与内膝眼配伍。临床针刺可略向内下斜入髌韧带深部，宜避开关节腔。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-35 (Dubi) is a point on the Stomach channel at the lateral knee eye. It quickens the blood, frees the network vessels, and dispels wind-damp. It is a key point for knee joint disorders, often combined with the medial knee eye.

acupoints.location: 犊鼻穴下3寸，胫骨前嵴外一横指（中指）处
acupoints.locationEn: 3 cun below ST-35 (Dubi), one finger-breadth lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia
indications: 胃痛、呕吐、腹胀、泄泻、便秘
acupoints.description: 足三里为足阳明胃经合穴，亦为胃之下合穴，列入四总穴及马丹阳天星十二穴，素有“保健要穴”之称。临床以健脾和胃、扶正培元见长，为治疗消化系统疾患及全身虚损性疾病的首选穴。古人云“若要安，三里常不干”，强调其灸治保健的重要地位。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-36 (Zusanli) is the he-sea point and lower he-sea point of the Stomach channel, and one of the four command points ("for the abdomen, take Zusanli") and Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. It is the single most important point for fortifying the Spleen and Stomach, supplementing qi, and supporting upright qi. Historically celebrated as the premier health-preservation moxibustion point, it is indispensable in the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders, general vacuity, and immune support.

acupoints.location: 小腿前外侧，犊鼻下6寸，胫骨前嵴外一横指处
acupoints.locationEn: On the anterolateral aspect of the lower leg, 6 cun below ST-35 (Dubi), one finger-breadth lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia
acupoints.description: 上巨虚为大肠之下合穴，善调肠胃、理气消滞，为治大肠腑病之要穴，尤擅治泄泻、痢疾、阑尾炎。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-37 (Shangjuxu) is the lower he-sea point of the Large Intestine. It regulates the intestines and stomach and disperses stagnation. It is the key point for Large Intestine bowel disorders, especially diarrhea, dysentery, and appendicitis.

acupoints.location: 小腿前外侧，犊鼻下8寸，胫骨前嵴外一横指处
acupoints.locationEn: On the anterolateral aspect of the lower leg, 8 cun below ST-35, one finger-breadth lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia
acupoints.description: 条口为足阳明胃经穴，善舒筋活络、祛风除湿。经验效穴治肩周炎，常透刺承山。临床针刺时提插捻转配合患肩活动，疗效尤佳。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-38 (Tiaokou) is a point on the Stomach channel known for relaxing the sinews and quickening the network vessels. It is an empirical point for frozen shoulder, often needled through to BL-57 (Chengshan). In clinical use, lifting-thrusting and rotating manipulation combined with active shoulder movement enhances therapeutic effect.

acupoints.location: 小腿前外侧，犊鼻下9寸，胫骨前嵴外一横指处
acupoints.locationEn: On the anterolateral aspect of the lower leg, 9 cun below ST-35, one finger-breadth lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia
acupoints.description: 下巨虚为小肠之下合穴，善调肠胃、清热利湿，为治小肠腑病之要穴，治腹痛泄泻、下肢痿痹。临床常与天枢、上巨虚同用以调小肠、大肠腑气。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-39 (Xiajuxu) is the lower he-sea point of the Small Intestine. It regulates the intestines and stomach and clears heat-dampness. It is the key point for Small Intestine bowel disorders, treating abdominal pain, diarrhea, and lower limb disorders.

acupoints.location: 小腿前外侧，外踝尖上8寸，条口外1寸，胫骨前嵴外二横指处
acupoints.locationEn: On the anterolateral aspect of the lower leg, 8 cun above the tip of the lateral malleolus, one finger-breadth lateral to ST-38, two finger-breadths lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia
acupoints.description: 丰隆为足阳明胃经络穴，联络足太阴脾经。为化痰第一要穴，善化痰降逆、健脾和胃，凡有形无形之痰皆可取之。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-40 (Fenglong) is the luo-connecting point of the Stomach channel, connecting to the Spleen channel. It is the foremost point for transforming phlegm. It resolves both substantial and insubstantial phlegm, fortifies the spleen, and calms the spirit.

acupoints.location: 足背与小腿交界处的横纹中央凹陷中，拇长伸肌腱与趾长伸肌腱之间
acupoints.locationEn: At the midpoint of the transverse crease of the ankle, between the tendons of extensor hallucis longus and extensor digitorum longus
acupoints.description: 解溪为足阳明胃经经穴，五行属火。善清胃热化痰、安神定志，治头面热证、癫狂及踝关节疾患。临床为踝关节扭伤、足下垂之常用穴。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-41 (Jiexi) is the jing-river point of the Stomach channel with the five-phase attribute of fire. It clears stomach heat, transforms phlegm, and calms the spirit. It treats heat patterns of the head and face, mania, and ankle disorders.

acupoints.location: 足背最高处，第二跖骨基底部与中间楔骨之间，足背动脉搏动处
acupoints.locationEn: On the highest point of the dorsum of the foot, between the 2nd metatarsal base and the intermediate cuneiform bone, where the dorsalis pedis artery pulsates
acupoints.description: 冲阳为足阳明胃经原穴，位于足背动脉搏动处。善和胃降逆、安神定志，为胃经原穴可治胃腑虚实诸证。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-42 (Chongyang) is the yuan-source point of the Stomach channel, located where the dorsalis pedis artery pulsates. It harmonizes the stomach, descends counterflow, and calms the spirit. As the source point, it treats both repletion and vacuity patterns of the stomach.

acupoints.location: 足背，第二、三趾间缝纹端
acupoints.locationEn: On the dorsum of the foot, at the proximal end of the web margin between the 2nd and 3rd toes
acupoints.description: 内庭为足阳明胃经荥穴，五行属水。善清胃泻火、理气止痛，为治牙痛、胃火上炎诸症之要穴。临床配合谷治阳明经头面火证，疗效显著。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-44 (Neiting) is the ying-spring point of the Stomach channel with the five-phase attribute of water. It excels at clearing stomach fire and stopping pain. It is a key point for toothache and conditions due to stomach fire flaming upward.

acupoints.location: 足第二趾末节外侧，距趾甲角0.1寸处
acupoints.locationEn: On the lateral side of the 2nd toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail
acupoints.depth: 浅刺或点刺出血 0.1–0.1 寸
acupoints.description: 厉兑为足阳明胃经井穴，五行属金。善清热和胃、开窍醒神，治热病、鼻衄、牙痛及神志病。临床多点刺出血以泄阳明实热，亦治梦魇不安。
acupoints.descriptionEn: ST-45 (Lidui) is the jing-well point of the Stomach channel with the five-phase attribute of metal. It clears heat, harmonizes the stomach, and opens the orifices to arouse the spirit. It treats febrile disease, nosebleed, toothache, and mental disorders.
